jobs.title: Research Program Coordinator – Reproductive Health
jobs.description:
**Employment Duration:** 6 months

The Research Program Coordinator will serve as a key analyst and coordinator supporting the programmatic and research activities of the Principal Investigator within UCSF’s Department of Obstetrics, Gynecology & Reproductive Sciences.

The position supports multiple grant-funded research projects focused on patient-provider communication, particularly in the areas of pharmacies, sexual and reproductive health, and empathy in healthcare. The Coordinator will conduct moderately complex qualitative and quantitative analytical work, support manuscript preparation and submission, and coordinate research, teaching, and mentorship activities. The research does not involve clinical trials.

The Coordinator will collaborate with UCSF departments, the San Francisco Department of Public Health, research and administrative partners, and outside consultants. The role will also evaluate research processes, data collection and storage practices, and available technologies and services to identify alternatives and make sound recommendations.

The position is within UCSF’s Department of Obstetrics, Gynecology & Reproductive Sciences, a major academic department in the School of Medicine committed to healthcare, education, and research. The role is based within the department’s Zuckerberg San Francisco General division, whose mission includes promoting justice, quality, and equity in women’s healthcare.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Conduct qualitative and quantitative data collection, cleaning, analysis, and other analytical activities supporting multiple research studies focused on patient-provider communication, pharmacies, sexual and reproductive health, and empathy in healthcare.
* Develop and support systems for research data collection, research-subject communication, and confidential data management.
* Prepare, edit, and modify manuscripts, presentations, abstracts, study instruments, research posters, syllabus materials, letters of recommendation, and other research-related documents.
* Conduct professional literature reviews and gather, synthesize, and analyze information to prepare reports and analyses for the Principal Investigator.
* Prepare and present research summaries, reports, and other materials for meetings and internal and external stakeholders.
* Coordinate research, teaching, and mentorship activities, including meetings, conference activities, research activities, grant applications, vendor selection and setup, and joint abstract submissions.
* Coordinate program and project activities with research and project staff and collaborate across UCSF departments and administrative units.
* Interface with partners including the Office of Sponsored Research, Research Administration, and San Francisco Department of Public Health departments as needed.
* Evaluate issues and research processes, gather relevant information, assess alternatives, and recommend approaches to data collection and storage based on available technologies and services.
* Support activities that advance UCSF PRIDE Values and Principles of Community and contribute to an inclusive environment where individuals are treated with dignity and respect.

  

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in any area.
* At least one year of related experience or equivalent training.
* Working knowledge of common organizational or research-specific computer applications, including Microsoft Office, particularly word processing and intermediate Excel functions.
* Proficient verbal and written communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to prioritize tasks and manage multiple responsibilities within demanding timeframes.
* Ability to exercise discretion and maintain confidentiality.
* Demonstrated ability to use sound judgment when responding to issues and concerns.
* Demonstrated ability to analyze, research, and synthesize large amounts of data with strong attention to detail.
* Demonstrated interest in sexual and reproductive health, including comfort with family planning and abortion, and infectious diseases including HIV.
* Knowledge of qualitative research concepts and applications.
Ability to take initiative and direction and complete tasks in a timely and comprehensive manner.  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in public health, behavioral science, or another related area.
* Three years of experience working in an academic, research, public health, or related setting.
* Knowledge of survey software such as REDCap or Qualtrics.

  

**About UCSF**

  

The University of California, San Francisco (UCSF) is a leading university dedicated to promoting health worldwide through advanced biomedical research, graduate-level education in the life sciences and health professions, and excellence in patient care. It is the only campus in the 10-campus UC system dedicated exclusively to the health sciences. We bring together the world’s leading experts in nearly every area of health. We are home to five Nobel laureates who have advanced the understanding of cancer, neurodegenerative diseases, aging and stem cells.

  
  

**Pride Values**

  

UCSF is a diverse community made of people with many skills and talents. We seek candidates whose work experience or community service has prepared them to contribute to our commitment to professionalism, respect, integrity, diversity and excellence – also known as our PRIDE values .

  

In addition to our PRIDE values, UCSF is committed to equity – both in how we deliver care as well as our workforce. We are committed to building a broadly diverse community, nurturing a culture that is welcoming and supportive, and engaging diverse ideas for the provision of culturally competent education, discovery, and patient care. Additional information about UCSF is available here .

  

Join us to find a rewarding career contributing to improving healthcare worldwide.

As a Mergers & Acquisitions Program Manager within Recruiting, you’ll be a key partner in leading the people-side workstream on M&A deals, from diligence through employee onboarding. This role demands sound judgment, speed, and discretion. You’ll operate at the center of some of OpenAI’s most impactful decisions - shaping the future of the company by bringing in extraordinary, mission-aligned talent.

We’re looking for someone who thrives in ambiguity, moves seamlessly between strategic thinking and execution, and is energized by complexity, challenge, and pace.

This role is based in San Francisco and requires flexibility to come into the office on short notice. Deal timelines can shift quickly, and the team coordinates coverage and checks in regularly on workload.

* Co-design, lead, and scale the M&A People XFN workstream program, driving end-to-end management of timeline, candidate experience, and key touchpoints that enable smooth deal execution and set the stage for positive onboarding and integration.

jobs.title: Case Manager
jobs.description:
Job Description:

**Case Manager**

**Zygmunt Arendt Support Services**

**Senior Division**

**Agency Overview**

Felton Institute responds to the needs of our community by providing innovative, evidence-informed social services that transform lives. Our organization offers 50+ programs that address mental health, the unhoused, early care and education, those impacted by the justice system, transitional age youth, as well as aging adults. Our programs combine the latest scientific research with cultural sensitivity and a deep commitment to supporting and reflecting the communities we serve. Felton offers a dynamic, challenging, and supportive work environment where we encourage the use of professional development, that staff can utilize throughout their career.

**Program and Division Description**

Felton’s Senior Division specializes in a full continuum of mental health services for older adults in outpatient clinics, the community, and supportive housing sites, as well as programs in employment training, economic security, case management, advocacy, and social connection and inclusion.

Felton’s Zygmunt Arendt Supportive Services Program provides on-site case management, wellness support, and behavioral health services. Services aim to support tenants in maintaining stable housing and improving access to resources. Tenants are formerly unhoused adults with co-occurring mental health, substance abuse, medical problems, and limited experience living independently. Support services include case management, referral to and coordination with primary medical care, substance abuse and psychiatric treatment referrals, benefits counseling and client advocacy, meal programs, health education, community building, tenant organizing, and all other case management functions. Felton is committed to implementing evidence-based practices and research within its community-based services.

**Job Description**

Under the supervision of the Lead Case Manager and/or supervisor, the Case Manager works in direct service with individuals experiencing homelessness, substance use, mental health needs, and medical complexity. The Case Manager holds a full caseload, works directly with the interdisciplinary team to reach out and engage all tenants, assess their needs upon move-in and throughout their residency, and connect tenants to those services, working to overcome obstacles with the residents and their care team. The Case Manager will connect tenants to services including benefits, entitlements, vocational or educational resources, mental health, medical, and substance use services, and any other appropriate resources, as needed. This person will also provide support to individuals in learning independent living skills, communication skills, social skills, and other necessary skills to support independence, maintain housing stability, and promote mental health recovery.

The Case Manager meets with and evaluates the needs of clients and develops a treatment plan in collaboration with the client. The Case Manager maintains accurate, detailed records of client contacts and incident reports as required by Felton, HSH, ONE system, and county and state regulations. This person will also bring expertise regarding the specific needs of older adults and those entering housing from homelessness, as well as connections to community resources, recreational opportunities, and other connections to necessary services.

**Specific Responsibilities**

* Participate closely with an interdisciplinary team and collaborate with property management.
* Communicate effectively, orally and in writing, with all internal and external team members and with partnering agencies.
* Participate in intakes and service plan development for adults with a history of being unhoused and other psychiatric or medical conditions or disabilities.
* Recommend case management services, which could include connection to primary care, coordination with other providers and community resources, housing stabilization services, etc.
* Link clients to basic needs, including income, housing, job training, insurance, and/or nutrition, among other resources.
* Maintain records of each client contact or service in accordance with mandated standards of HSH and Felton. Meet requirements of timely access for client care and documentation.
* Participate in team meetings and case conferences through presentation of cases, discussion of issues, and exchange of information and ideas.
* Provide crisis intervention to prevent hospitalization and collaborate with clinicians or other providers as needed. Respond to emergency situations as they arise.
* Develop systems and maintain ongoing training, including developing specializations in evidence-based practices for the teams.
* Accountable for data input into the ONE and CIRCE systems to maintain client records related to housing per HSH standards.
* Deliver exceptional customer service to tenants, community partners, and team.
* Provide activities and groups with the tenants.
* Advise tenants to basic needs, including income, housing, job training, insurance, and/or nutrition, among other resources.
* Recommend specific housing needs via training, coaching, or community resource referrals to support tenants in maintaining stable housing.
* Participate in emergency wellness checks.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Social Work, Psychology, or related fields of study required.
* Comprehensive knowledge of mental health and substance abuse counseling, assessment, and crisis intervention skills.
* Willingness to work from a strength-based, harm reduction, client-centered model with an emphasis on evidence-based practices.
* Ability to work cooperatively on a multidisciplinary team, and to work with people of various ethnic and cultural backgrounds.
* Strong organizational, communication, documentation, time management, and interpersonal skills.

jobs.description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.
  
  
Research Capital & Site Operations Manager
  
  
Summary
  
This role sits where capital planning meets day-to-day lab operations. You’ll decide where capital dollars go, keep our research sites running, and manage the vendors and facilities that make the science possible. Your job is to make sure labs have the equipment, supplies, and services they need, and that our space and infrastructure keep pace as discovery programs grow. You’ll weigh cost, risk, and impact, then turn those calls into clear plans. The goal is simple: researchers spend their time on discovery, not on broken equipment or unresolved facility issues.
  
  
**Roles and Responsibilities of the Position:**  

* Identify and manage external vendors across multiple functions within the facility operation to ensure alignment with LRL and Oncology department heads and scientists.
* Responsible for oversight of the installation and qualification of laboratory equipment.
* Work with the LRL HSE and IT department teams on strategy, long-term planning, new construction, and project execution.
* Manage and review service contracts.
* Oversee the design, construction and occupancy of laboratory and office spaces for the LRL employees on site.
* Check completed work by vendors and contractors.
* Contribute to the creation of Site Operational Budgets and annual Site Capital Budgets for LRL. Ensure site budgets are managed and maintained. Provide budget forecasts for site as required.
* Frequent contact and interaction with department heads, outside agencies/architects, and government and municipal representatives.
* Allocate office space according to needs of LRL personnel.
* Keep financial and non-financial records.
* Forecast, allocate, and supervise the financial and physical resources of the facility management.
* Recommend maintenance, mechanical, electrical, and facility design modifications.
* Prepare cost estimates for moves and equipment.
* Ensure that the facility is clean and maintained according to company policy and procedures.
* Negotiate bids and contracts for third-party services.
* Manage and coordinate work with 3rd-party vendors including tracking work order completion, vendor and client follow up, validating/approving subcontractor invoices.
* Oversee the implementation of Health, Safety and Environmental programs for LRL and Oncology personnel on site.
* Conduct and document regular Facilities & HSE inspections.
* Manage the upkeep of equipment and supplies to meet the required health and safety standards.
* Support preparing for, responding to and taking corrective action for HSE or other site audits.
* Maintaining a safe work environment for all employees.
* Serve as emergency response coordinator for LRL Operations and attend site emergency preparedness meetings.
* Maintain regular communication with building landlord, staying current on building requirements that could impact LRL Operations.
* Other duties as required.

**Basic Qualifications:**  

* Bachelor’s Degree
* 2+ years’ experience managing facilities, laboratories, or site operations
* Experience selecting, managing, and negotiating with external vendors and contractors
* Experience managing vendors and internal stakeholders so resources line up with research needs

**Preferred Qualifications:**  

* Familiarity with facilities and operations in a research setting, including capital projects
* Experience leading medium-sized projects with moderate risk and resource demands
* Understanding of capacity planning, including matching space and equipment to project demand
* Comfort using collaboration tools to coordinate work across teams

Experience working with and analyzing data, and managing multiple projects.  

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

**About the job**
-----------------

Product and Business Strategy Leaders bring together teams across Google’s functions to help products execute optimally. Our team pushes Google to scale at key points that refine our products and infrastructure by executing efficiently, bringing solid business sense and sound judgment, and working effectively across organizational lines.

jobs.description:
**Company Description**

Guardant Health is a leading precision oncology company focused on guarding wellness and giving every person more time free from cancer. Founded in 2012, Guardant® is transforming patient care and accelerating new cancer therapies by providing critical insights into what drives disease through its advanced blood and tissue tests, real-world data and AI analytics. Guardant tests help improve outcomes across all stages of care, including screening to find cancer early, monitoring for recurrence in early-stage cancer, and treatment selection for patients with advanced cancer. For more information, visit guardanthealth.com and follow the company on LinkedIn , X (Twitter) and Facebook .

The Manager, Business Operations is a trusted operational partner to Client Services Executive team. You will turn business priorities into coordinated plans, lead cross-functional initiatives, and provide executive support that keeps leaders focused on the business. You will bring structure, accountability, and consistency to operations across teams.

Working with limited supervision, you will own assigned programs and operational processes within approved priorities, budgets, and delegated authority. You will weigh competing demands, resolve issues, recommend solutions, and escalate decisions that need leadership approval. Success requires sound judgment, discretion, strong follow-through, and the ability to balance program ownership with hands-on executive support.

  
  

**What You’ll Do**

**Business Planning and Program Execution**
-------------------------------------------

* Partner with Client Services leadership on organizational and operational planning, translating approved priorities into work plans with clear deliverables, timelines, owners, and success measures.

  

* Lead cross-functional initiatives on behalf of executive leadership, managing scope, schedules, approved budgets, dependencies, and risks, and driving accountability for commitments. Escalate material changes to scope, resources, or commitments for leadership approval.

  

* Work with the Workforce Planning Manager to coordinate monthly headcount adjustments, consolidate inputs, track leadership decisions, and support implementation of approved staffing changes. The Workforce Planning Manager owns workforce analysis, staffing forecasts, and recommendations; Client Services leadership approves staffing decisions through established

organizational processes.

  

* Run the recurring Client Services business review process, including scheduling, contributor deadlines, consolidation of performance data and presentation materials, and follow-up on decisions and action items. Functional owners remain accountable for the accuracy and completeness of their submissions.

  

* Align priorities and coordinate execution with Sales, Marketing, the Client Services Center of Excellence, and other stakeholders.

  

* Coordinate business process outsourcing (BPO) logistics in support of decisions made by senior leaders and designated functional owners.

  
  

**Executive Partnership and Communications**
--------------------------------------------

* Anticipate executive needs and tailor support to leadership priorities, communication styles, and decision-making preferences.

  

* Assess incoming requests and issues, then resolve, route, defer, or escalate them within delegated authority and company policy.

  

* Prepare and coordinate executive presentations, briefings, business review materials, and sensitive internal and external correspondence, obtaining appropriate review and approval before distribution.

  

* Facilitate cross-departmental communication so stakeholders understand decisions, commitments, and next steps.

  

* Identify commitments, operational risks, and unresolved matters that need leadership attention, and recommend action.

  
  

**Financial and Administrative Operations**
-------------------------------------------

* Support development and management of the Client Services operating budget with leadership and Finance, including tracking expenditures, identifying variances, and coordinating follow-up. Budget ownership and spending authorization remain with designated business leaders and authorized approvers.

  

* Coordinate vendor engagement, contract review and approval workflows, purchase orders, and invoice processing in line with procurement policies. Contract execution and purchasing approvals remain with authorized signatories and approvers.

  

* Manage executive expense reporting and corporate card purchases within established authorization limits, maintaining accurate records and policy compliance.

  

* Track budgets and spending for assigned projects, meetings, recognition programs, and team activities; flag anticipated overruns and obtain approval before commitments exceed approved budgets.

  
  

**Executive Scheduling, Meetings, and Travel**
----------------------------------------------

* Manage complex calendars for the VP and, as needed, the SVP, prioritizing meetings, preparation time, and travel within agreed executive preferences and leadership direction. Escalate competing executive priorities that require leadership resolution.

  

* Coordinate leadership meetings, offsites, and team-building activities, including agendas, materials, logistics, and action tracking.

  

* Arrange domestic and international travel within company policy and approved budgets, prepare itineraries and meeting context, account for time zones, and manage schedule changes.

  

* Maintain the Client Services team calendar and communicate key deadlines, events, and milestones.

  
  

**Team Programs and Enablement**
--------------------------------

* Manage administration of the Client Services awards and recognition program with the Workforce Planning Manager and leadership, including nomination workflows, selection logistics, approved budgets, award fulfillment, and recipient

jobs.title: Reality Labs Product Data Operations Program Manager - AI Data and Evaluation
jobs.description:
Meta is seeking a Reality Labs Product Data Operations Program Manager to drive human data annotation, AI-assisted quality, and model and data evaluation across Reality Labs, where capabilities like hand tracking, gesture recognition, and generative AI experiences depend on models trained and evaluated on high-quality human data.Our scope spans the full lifecycle of the data: designing the tasks that produce it, deploying AI and automation to scale how it is labeled and checked, and building the evaluation practices that decide whether the data and model outputs meet the bar.If you are energized by AI-driven workflows and measurement rigor, this role is for you. You will take ownership of an established set of operational tools and extend them as programs grow. You should be excited and comfortable using AI coding tools and owning the results.  
  
  

### **Reality Labs Product Data Operations Program Manager - AI Data and Evaluation Responsibilities:**

* Own a portfolio of annotation and evaluation programs across Meta Reality Labs' perception and generative AI experiences, running each through established workflows and shared tooling so every delivery can be traced, reproduced, and handed off
* Partner with research scientists, engineers, and technical program managers to translate model and evaluation requirements into task designs, rubrics, rater guidelines, and acceptance criteria
* Operate, maintain, and extend existing program tooling, including task configurations, data pipelines, queries, dashboards, and automated reports, with the help of AI coding assistants
* Define how quality is measured for each program: break down what a correct answer means into verifiable checks, set the acceptance rules a delivery must pass, and decide how rater disagreement is resolved, rather than applying one-size-fits-all metrics
* Design, configure, and operate AI and automation across the annotation pipeline, including pre-annotation, LLM and VLM judges, and quality triage, and measure where they meet the bar before they replace a human step
* Build and maintain evaluation practices, including gold-standard datasets, model versus human comparison, human preference evaluation for generative models, and the accuracy thresholds that determine whether data and AI outputs meet the bar
* Analyze operational data to identify quality and throughput trends, building the dashboards and leadership-facing reporting that drive decisions, and stating the coverage behind every quality number
* Drive resolution of risks and blockers across vendor capacity, tooling, data availability, and model training schedules
* Manage external annotation vendors, including rater training, throughput, quality feedback, and per-unit cost. Document the systems and decisions you own so that any program can be handed to another program manager without loss

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining a Bachelor's degree in a directly related field, or equivalent practical experience. Degree must be completed prior to joining Meta
* Bachelor's degree in a directly related field, or equivalent practical experience
* 4+ years of experience in program management, operations, or technical operations within an AI, ML, research, or data-driven organization
* Analytical experience using data to identify trends, diagnose operational issues, and influence program direction
* Experience building or deploying automation or AI solutions in production workflows
* Experience in communicating and influencing multiple cross-functional stakeholders and leadership
* Experience solving problems and breaking down ambiguous issues into component parts to develop solutions
* Familiarity with AI/ML concepts, applications, and industry trends sufficient to engage with technical teams and inform operational decisions

  
  
  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience in AR/VR, wearables, or consumer electronics, or with perception data such as hand, body, or eye tracking
* Experience running human data annotation programs at scale, including task design, rater guidelines, and quality measures for tasks with no gold standard
* Experience using AI coding agents to build or maintain operational tooling, reports, or workflows
* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
* Experience owning program budgets, cost forecasting, or per-unit cost tracking
* Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)
* Experience designing evaluations for generative AI systems, including rubrics, human preference studies, or LLM-as-judge methods
* Working familiarity with how computer vision and machine learning models are trained and evaluated, including benchmark datasets, ground truth, accuracy, and agreement measurement, and a high-level understanding of model limitations
* Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies
* Experience in writing SQL to analyze large datasets

  
  
  

### **About Meta:**

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics.

jobs.title: Parish Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**CHURCH OF OUR SAVIOUR, MILL VALLEY - OPERATIONS MANAGER**

**POSITION DESCRIPTION**

**Overview:**

The Operations Manager has general responsibility for the management of all office functions,

bookkeeping and overseeing the maintenance and repair of the buildings and grounds of

the Episcopal Church of Our Saviour, Mill Valley. The person in this role will often be the first

impression members of the public and parishioners have of the parish and so in addition to

ensuring that the operations of the parish all are smoothly running, this person should enjoy

creating a warm and hospitable environment. All are Welcome at the Church of Our Saviour.

This position reports directly to the acting Rector of the parish and provides him/her direct

administrative support while also providing administrative support to the Vestry (lay board of

the parish), other clergy, and key parish ministry leaders.

**Key Responsibilities: (detailed accountabilities below)**

● Bookkeeping - this role will be responsible for timely and accurate bookkeeping for the

parish, including payables and receivables, donation and pledge management, regular

reporting for diocesan and parish needs, review of invoices, and handling deposits.

● Office functions - the successful Operations Manager ensures that the office is well

organized, well-equipped, tidy, welcoming and stocked and that systems and processes,

tools and technologies are in place to absorb requests from across the parish. The office

functions of the Operations Managers will include administrative tasks (such as

scheduling facilities use, responding to and appropriately directing phone and email

inquiries, managing the office accounts, subscriptions, machines and supplies), member

management (including maintaining and filing parish records, meeting minutes,

updating the parish directory, developing a robust communications program, ensuring all

announcements and events are published across communications channels and digital

platforms) and leader support (including staff and ministry leaders with scheduling

volunteers, procuring necessary supplies, and producing materials for church services,

such as bulletins, hand-outs, music inserts, etc.)

● Building and Grounds Management - in coordination with Junior Warden, the Office

Manager is responsible for scheduling regular and ad hoc work, for the maintenance and

repair of COS facilities (including church building, grounds and nearby rectory) and

ensures successful and timely completion of maintenance and repairs. This includes

management of janitorial services, gardening and landscaping services, handymen and

specialist service providers (musical instrument maintenance, stained glass repair,

plumbing, electrical, etc.)

**Required Qualifications and Competencies:**

● Equivalent to a minimum of three (3) years of administrative experience;

● Facility with computers and applications related to the work, including word processing,

spreadsheet applications, web design, database / CRM, and SaaS workspaces are a

must;

● Knowledge of basic accounting and bookkeeping practices;

● Strong english language skills, including, spelling, grammar, and punctuation relevant to

business communications;

● Ability to understand, interpret, apply, and explain the church’s policies and procedures;

● Use of tact, initiative, discretion, and judgment within church policy and legal guidelines

in sensitive situations;

● Ability to establish, maintain, and foster positive and effective working relationships with

those contacted in the course of work;

● Ability to provide a high level of customer service when dealing with the public,

parishioners, church staff and volunteers;

● Demonstrated ability to organize own work, set priorities, meet critical deadlines and

follow-up on assignments;

● Propensity to take initiative and exercise independent judgement in decision making

within the scope of the role;

● Ability to effectively coordinate the work of certain vendors, contractors, and service

providers through delivery of clear instruction and timely responses

● Ability and desire to effectively leverage technology to improve efficiency of office

processes and systems

● Willingness and desire to observe any operating gaps and to “fill-in” when needed with

other duties as needed or as assigned.

● Experience in a church or other ministry setting is preferred. Knowledge of the

Episcopal Church is a huge plus.

**Detailed Accountabilities:**

**Bookkeeping:**

● Reviews invoices for payment, forwards to appropriate individuals for approval and

follows up until approval is received.

● Handles entry and resolution of all payables and receivables.

● Tracks donation and annual pledges.

● Provides regular reporting for the Diocese of California.

● Provides regular financial reports for the Finance Committee and Vestry review.

● Prepares for and participates in monthly finance committee meetings.

● Assists in preparation of annual parish reports to the congregation and diocese.

● Prepares weekly deposit slips for offerings and checks received.

● Distributes quarterly and annual mailings to pledging parishioners.

● Submitting hourly payroll schedule.

● Reconciling bank account.

● Paying diocesan assessment.

● Paying employee benefits.

● Paying pensions.

**Office Functions:**

● Responds to requests for information and resources via email, telephone, and in-person

visits.

● Sorts incoming mail; sends parish mailings and other outgoing mail.

● Maintains office equipment and office subscriptions: including copiers, computers, and

telephone system in working order; coordinates service as needed.

● Maintains office supplies and supplies needed for ministries.

● Maintains licenses, passwords, and media for computer related tools and services used

by or for the parish (e.g., computer applications, website, ISP, telephone, equipment).

● Maintains personnel files for all regular staff

jobs.description:
**About Sifted**

Jess Legge and Kimberly Lexow were masters of the 9 to 5 - working at a high-growth tech start-up, with one question: “Could the work lunch be better?”

It’s an expectation these days that work is hard and fast. But lunch doesn’t have to be that way. Imagining an office where employees want to stick around and share a table of inspired food, Legge and Lexow founded Sifted in 2015.

Since then we’ve delivered millions of meals to Fortune 500s and high-growth startups across the US. When COVID-19 hit, our clients needed a partner to help them manage their new normal. That’s when we created our virtual team building experiences. Now as companies fully embrace the future of a flexible workplace, Sifted has become a comprehensive employee experience partner offering both in-office catering services + an extensive portfolio of engaging virtual experiences for distributed teams.

We use 7 core truths as the framework of our employee engagement programs and team culture :

  

* Good food is powerful
* Simple food is the best food
* We support regular people with big ideas
* We make mistakes and evolve
* We appreciate people’s differences
* We seek, listen and implement feedback quickly + enthusiastically
* We are our clients’ biggest fans

Sifted kitchens are zero food waste with all food scraps being composted and all leftovers being donated everyday. Since launching our donation program, Sifted has donated over $3M in lunches to those who experience food insecurity in our 6 cities. jobs.title: GTM Enablement Manager
jobs.description:
At Braze, we have found our people. We're a genuinely approachable, exceptionally kind, and intensely passionate crew.

We seek to ignite that passion by setting high standards, championing teamwork, and creating work-life harmony as we collectively navigate rapid growth on a global scale while striving for greater equity and opportunity – inside and outside our organization.

To flourish here, you must be prepared to set a high bar for yourself and those around you. There is always a way to contribute: Acting with autonomy, having accountability and being open to new perspectives are essential to our continued success.

Our deep curiosity to learn and our eagerness to share diverse passions with others gives us balance and injects a one-of-a-kind vibrancy into our culture.

If you are driven to solve exhilarating challenges and have a bias toward action in the face of change, you will be empowered to make a real impact here, with a sharp and passionate team at your back. If Braze sounds like a place where you can thrive, we can't wait to meet you.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

As a Product Enablement Manager, you'll make sure Braze's most technical customer-facing teams fully understand our product. This job has two main work streams. You'll run the internal process for building product enablement, taking each project from intake to launch so content is accurate, on time, and matched to the release calendar. You'll also run deep, hands-on enablement sessions for Technical Account Managers (TAMs), Technical Architects (TAs), Support, and Solutions Consultants (SCs), so they can design, troubleshoot, and position Braze with confidence.

*Project Management*

* Design and own the end-to-end process for building internal product enablement: intake, prioritization, scoping, timelines, SME coordination, content review, and launch
* Line up enablement deliverables with the product release calendar so technical teams are ready before features reach customers
* Coordinate across Product, Engineering, Product Marketing, Documentation, and the broader Enablement team so everyone knows who owns what, what's due when, and what's been approved
* Build and maintain repeatable templates, workflows, and tracking (e.g., Jira, or Claude) that make the build process scalable and visible to stakeholders
* Share status, risks, and tradeoffs with stakeholders early, and adjust priorities quickly when launches or business needs change

*Technical Product Enablement*

* Design and deliver deep, hands-on enablement sessions (labs, workshops, live demos, and troubleshooting walkthroughs) built around the day-to-day work of TAMs, TAs, Support, and SCs
* Create and maintain resources such as technical FAQs, reference architectures, sandbox exercises, recorded deep-dives, and certification paths, working with SMEs in Product, Engineering, and Product Marketing
* Run regular needs assessments with technical team leaders to find knowledge gaps, recurring escalation themes, and support case trends, then turn them into targeted enablement
* Measure impact with assessments, certification completion, survey feedback, and operational data (e.g., ticket deflection, time-to-resolution, escalation volume, technical win rates), and use the results to improve programs

**WHO YOU ARE**

* 3+ years of experience in technical or product enablement, with a strong track record of designing and delivering advanced technical training and project management
* 7+ years of combined experience in a technical customer-facing or product role (e.g., Technical Account Manager, Technical Architect, Solutions Consultant, Technical Support, Sales Engineer, or Product)
* Strong hands-on knowledge of APIs, SDKs, data integrations, and common programming concepts. You're comfortable going deep with highly technical audiences
* Experience with Braze or another customer engagement platform; experience with mobile/web SDK implementation is a strong plus
* Proven program and project management skills, including running multi-stakeholder content development cycles against fixed launch dates
* Ability to simplify complex technical concepts without losing accuracy, and to tailor content for different technical roles
* Strong relationship management skills, with credibility among engineers, product managers, and technical team leaders
* Analytical skills to assess data, find trends, and turn insights into actionable enablement
* Experience with LMS platforms, sandbox/lab environments, and content authoring tools is a plus
* A Bachelor's degree in a relevant field or equivalent practical experience
* Moderate travel required
* Business-fluent English is essential

If you enjoy getting deep into the technical details, running complex projects to completion, and helping technical teams become trusted experts for our customers, we'd love to hear from you.

For candidates based in the United States, the pay range for this position at the start of employment is expected to be between $101,000 and $130,000/year with an expected On Target Earnings (OTE) between $123,000 and $160,000/year (including bonus or commission). Your exact offer may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including market location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. In addition to cash compensation, this role qualifies for a comprehensive Total Rewards package that includes equity grants of restricted stock (RSUs) so that you will own a piece of our company.

**WHAT WE OFFER**

*Braze benefits vary by location, and we encourage you to review our specific benefits offerings for each country at* *here**. More details on benefits plans will be provided if you receive an offer of employment.*

From offering comprehensive benefits to fostering hybrid ways of working, we've got you covered so you can prioritize work-life harmony. Braze offers benefits such as:

* Competitive compensation that may include equity
* Retirement and Employee Stock Purchase Plans
* Flexible paid time off

jobs.title: Mission Management Program Manager
jobs.description:
Astranis builds advanced satellites for high orbits, expanding humanity's reach into the solar system. Today Astranis satellites provide dedicated, secure networks to highly-sophisticated customers across the globe – large enterprises, sovereign governments, and the US military.

With five satellites on orbit and many more set to launch soon, the company is servicing a backlog of more than $1 billion of commercial contracts. Astranis is the preferred satellite communications partner for buyers with stringent requirements for uptime, data security, network visibility, and customization.

Astranis has raised over $1.2 billion from some of the world's best investors, including Andreessen Horowitz, Baillie Gifford, Blackrock, Fidelity, Franklin Templeton, and Snowpoint, and employs a team of 500 engineers and entrepreneurs. Astranis designs, builds, and operates its satellites out of its 153,000 sq. ft. headquarters in Northern California, USA.

#### **Mission Management Program Manager**

Astranis is building and operating a growing fleet of spacecraft, with each mission requiring coordination across spacecraft engineering, ground systems, network services, launch, operations, and customer teams.  
The Mission Management Program Manager will be responsible for coordinating the end-to-end execution of assigned missions across these organizations. This role will establish integrated mission plans, drive cross-functional alignment both internally and externally, identify and resolve dependencies, and ensure the organization is prepared to execute key mission milestones.  
This is a highly cross-functional individual contributor role. The Mission Manager will work across organizational boundaries and influence technical and functional leaders to balance Astranis and customer needs.  
  
**Role**

* Develop and maintain external facing customer schedules, progress updates and technical briefing content for each customer
* Lead planning and preparation for recurring weekly mission execution reviews and ensure critical issues are surfaced and resolved
* Identify cross-functional dependencies and ensure appropriate owners and actions are established
* Coordinate mission readiness activities leading to launch, deployment, commissioning, and operational handoff
* Establish and maintain mission readiness criteria and track organizational readiness against those criteria
* Support development and continuous improvement of Astranis' mission-management processes, tools, and operating cadence
* Standardize deliverable templates and own preparation of customer milestone reviews in coordination with Spacecraft and Ground PMs
* Collaborate with Sales and Network Planning during term sheet and capacity agreement development on technical exhibits and SOW
* Filter all technical information shared with customers to ensure appropriate disclosure boundaries are maintained)

**Requirements**

* 2+ years of experience in program management, systems engineering, mission operations, aerospace, defense, or another complex technical environment
* Experience coordinating complex, cross-functional technical programs, with internal and external stakeholders
* Strong understanding of systems engineering and system-level dependencies
* Experience working across engineering, sales, and operations organizations
* Experience with spacecraft, launch, mission operations, ground systems, or other highly integrated technical systems preferred
* Strong organizational and analytical skills, with the ability to turn ambiguity into clear plans and actions
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Ability to influence without formal authority and drive accountability across organizational boundaries
* Demonstrated ability to identify problems before they become schedule or mission-impacting issues

jobs.title: Staff Program Manager: Customer Success
jobs.description:
**Overview**
------------

Join Intuit as a Staff Program Manager on the Customer Success team. This is a high-impact role for someone who enjoys building structure, driving execution, and turning complex ideas into clear, actionable programs.

In this role, you’ll define and lead cross-functional programs that support our global customer base. You’ll work in ambiguous spaces, partner closely with product, operations, and go-to-market teams, and own programs end to end, from outcomes and governance model through delivery and sustained adoption. You’ll connect business strategy to execution, make the tradeoffs clear, and keep teams focused on the work that matters most.

This role requires strong operational fundamentals, deep domain expertise, and the ability to run multiple workstreams at once. You’ll regularly present recommendations to senior leaders, lead experts through problem solving, and use AI and the best available tools alongside human judgment to move faster and raise the quality of the work. You’ll also help raise the bar for the craft by sharing what works with your peers.

**Responsibilities**

* **Connect Strategy to Execution:** Translate business strategy, customer context, and internal realities into clear priorities, decisions, and execution paths across a complex program or multiple programs. Lead tradeoff discussions, recommend a path forward, and make sure decisions are followed through.
* **Program Design & Launch:** Partner across teams to define program outcomes and success metrics aligned to Customer Success and GBSG goals, build the program framework and end-to-end delivery plan, and establish the governance model.
* **Operating Rhythm:** Develop and drive the operating rhythm for your programs to set direction, monitor performance, and create clear accountability. Lead workstream owners to meet program success measures.
* **Risk, Dependencies & Clear Communication:** Partner across teams to uncover risks and dependencies early, escalate blockers, and quickly determine the path to green. Use data and insights to communicate progress and trends, recommend decisions, and propose changes to the plan.
* **Domain Expertise:** Rapidly get up to speed on new program areas and build an end-to-end blueprint. Use deep domain knowledge to ask the right questions, bring in the right experts, address process and priority gaps, and lead those experts through problem solving to shape decisions.
* **Lead Change:** Build credibility and trust across teams as a boundaryless change leader. Identify the impacts of key changes, develop the change plan, and drive it from plan to sustained adoption with a compelling, data-backed case for change.
* **AI & Tools:** Use AI and analytical tools as thought partners to speed up analysis, sharpen recommendations, and surface risks, while holding AI-assisted outputs to the same quality bar as any other work.
* **Enable Scale & Velocity:** Contribute new frameworks, practices, and templates, enhance existing ones, and adopt approaches proven by peers. Experiment with new approaches, including AI, tie them to outcomes, and share learnings so they scale across programs. Coach others on program management fundamentals.

**Qualifications**

* 7+ years of experience leading cross-functional programs in a SaaS or technology environment.
* Experience in ambiguous problem spaces, bringing structure, clarity, and momentum to new initiatives.
* Strong program management fundamentals, including end-to-end planning, governance, risk and dependency management, and stakeholder coordination.
* Data-driven mindset, with the ability to use metrics and insights to recommend decisions and communicate progress and risks.
* Proven ability to present recommendations to senior leaders and drive decisions across teams.
* Ability to operate at both the strategic level (goals, priorities, tradeoffs) and the tactical level (day-to-day execution).
* Track record of leading change, from building the case through sustained adoption, and influencing without authority.
* Hands-on experience using AI tools to accelerate analysis, communication, and program delivery, with sound judgment on quality.
* Clear, effective communicator in both written and verbal formats.
* Passion for customer success and delivering real, measurable impact.

Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position may be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit®: Careers | Benefits). Pay offered is based on factors such as job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and work location. To drive ongoing fair pay for employees, Intuit conducts regular comparisons across categories of ethnicity and gender.

The expected base pay range for this position is:
  
Mountain View $158,000 - $214,000
  
San Diego, CA $150,000- $203,000

We are establishing a dedicated Customer Program Management function within our Commercial organization and are seeking our first Customer Program Manager to help build and scale this critical capability. Reporting to the Senior Manager, Global Customer Program Management, this role serves as the operational control point between customer purchase orders and company acceptance.

The Customer Program Manager is responsible for ensuring every customer order is accurately received, reviewed, validated, screened for compliance, price-verified, and routed for approval before becoming a business commitment. Once an order is accepted, the Customer Program Manager serves as the primary day-to-day operational contact for customers regarding order status, changes, delays, returns, and program execution.

This role is uniquely positioned at the intersection of customer satisfaction, operational excellence, and regulatory compliance. Success requires exceptional attention to detail, strong process discipline, and the ability to manage complex order and compliance requirements in a highly regulated hardware manufacturing environment.

**Order Management & Customer Program Support**

* Manage the centralized customer order intake process and serve as the primary owner of the order management workflow.
* Receive, log, validate, and enter customer purchase orders into company systems, ensuring completeness, accuracy, and adherence to established procedures.
* Review orders for duplicates, discrepancies, and missing information prior to processing.
* Issue order acknowledgments following required internal approvals.
* Process order modifications, cancellations, expedites, and other customer-requested changes while ensuring compliance with established controls.
* Serve as the primary customer contact for order status updates, delivery schedules, backlog management, and issue resolution.

**Purchase Order Review & Contract Compliance**

* Review customer purchase orders and associated terms and conditions for alignment with approved commercial and legal requirements.
* Identify deviations from approved contractual terms and coordinate review and resolution with Legal Counsel and relevant stakeholders.
* Ensure no non-standard terms or exceptions are accepted without proper authorization.
* Maintain complete documentation and audit trails supporting purchase order reviews, approvals, and exceptions.
* Verify customer pricing against approved system pricing and escalate discrepancies for resolution.

**Trade Compliance & Regulatory Support**

* Perform customer, ship-to, consignee, and end-user screening against applicable restricted party and sanctions lists.
* Document screening results and resolve routine false-positive matches in accordance with established procedures.
* Escalate potential compliance concerns to Legal Counsel or designated compliance personnel for review.
* Collect, maintain, and manage End-Use Certificates and other export compliance documentation required for international transactions.
* Monitor compliance-related order holds and proactively drive timely resolution with internal stakeholders.
* Ensure all customer order activities comply with applicable export control and trade compliance regulations.

**Customer Communication & Returns Management**

* Act as the primary operational liaison between customers and internal teams including Sales, Operations, Supply Chain, Logistics, Quality, and Finance.
* Communicate order status, schedule changes, delays, and recovery plans in a timely and professional manner.
* Coordinate product return authorizations and return processing activities with internal functional teams.
* Escalate commercial disputes, contract issues, and pricing matters to the appropriate account owner and management team.
* Build and maintain strong customer relationships through proactive communication and effective issue resolution.

**Process Ownership & Continuous Improvement**

* Own and maintain Customer Program Management procedures, work instructions, and process documentation.
* Ensure processes remain current, effective, and compliant with evolving business and regulatory requirements.
* Compile and maintain customer risk assessments and related reporting.
* Develop scalable processes and documentation that support organizational growth and knowledge transfer.
* Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, data accuracy, customer experience, and compliance performance.
* Generate metrics, reports, and dashboards to support management decision-making and operational reviews.

 **Requirements**

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Supply Chain Management, International Trade, Engineering, Operations Management, or a related field.
* Minimum of 5 years of experience in customer program management, order management, sales operations, trade compliance operations, customer service, or a related role within a manufacturing environment.
* Experience managing customer orders and operational processes within an ERP-based business environment.
* Working knowledge of export controls, sanctions screening, and international trade documentation requirements.
* Experience using Salesforce, ERP systems, or similar business applications with a strong focus on data accuracy and process integrity.
* Excellent organizational skills and exceptional attention to detail.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate effectively with customers, executives, legal teams, and cross-functional stakeholders.
* Proven ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively in a fast-paced environment.
* Demonstrated ability to apply sound judgment while operating within defined policies and approval frameworks.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience within battery technology, energy storage, aerospace, defense, eVTOL/UAV, semiconductor, electronics, or other highly regulated hardware industries.
* Familiarity with export c

jobs.title: Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
Project Coordinator

**Company:** Componentry  
**Location:** Fremont, CA — fully onsite  
**Reports to:** President  
**Type:** Full-time, non-exempt, hourly  
**Schedule:** Monday–Friday, 8 a.m.–4:30 p.m., including a 30-minute unpaid meal break  
**Pay:** $28–$42 per hour, depending on relevant experience and demonstrated skills

About Componentry

Componentry helps hardware companies source and manage materials, build electronic and electromechanical assemblies, and keep production moving. We work as an extension of our customers’ teams, from quoting and procurement through production.

We’re looking for a Project Coordinator to connect the people, information, and actions needed to carry customer jobs from order review through delivery.

The role

You’ll maintain a clear picture of active jobs, follow up on commitments, identify risks, and coordinate solutions so work keeps moving.

Working directly with our President, you’ll partner with procurement, receiving, production, suppliers, and customers. You’ll track what has been purchased, what is outstanding, what is ready to kit or build, and what needs to happen to meet delivery commitments.

You’ll own the shared job dashboard and connect existing purchasing sheets, receiving records, and production schedules. Information should be accessible to the team without someone having to reconstruct a status report whenever an update is needed.

We’re open to training someone with strong organization, initiative, and follow-through. Your independence and decision-making authority will grow as you learn our business and demonstrate sound judgment.

What you’ll ownJob planning and visibility

* Review new orders against quoted lead times, checking material availability and production capacity with the team.
* Establish job milestones and flag conditions that could affect the expected schedule.
* Maintain the shared job dashboard, including purchasing progress, material delivery dates, receiving status, kit readiness, production, inspection, and shipment.
* Connect information across existing records and improve trackers and handoffs where needed.
* Keep blockers, next actions, owners, and deadlines visible.
* Establish regular updates with the team and escalate missing information or unresolved actions that put delivery at risk.
* Maintain traceability between customer jobs, purchase orders, and materials, including purchases supporting multiple jobs.

Follow-through and recovery

* Follow up with procurement on unpurchased items, supplier commitments, outstanding deliveries, and purchasing blockers.
* Follow up with receiving and production on discrepancies, kit completion, build progress, inspection, and rework.
* Identify stalled work, establish the next action with the responsible person, and follow through to resolution.
* Develop recovery plans with procurement and production, using their expertise to evaluate feasible options.
* Coordinate recovery actions and authorize expenses within established limits as responsibility grows.
* Escalate competing customer priorities, unresolved feasibility disagreements, and decisions outside your authority with options and a recommendation.
* Raise risks early enough for the team to respond.

Customer and supplier communication

* Confirm customer requirements, requested dates, and delivery arrangements.
* Obtain supplier shipment commitments, tracking information, and missing documents.
* Communicate job progress, outstanding dependencies, and schedule changes clearly.
* Work with the team and customer to agree on achievable recovery dates within established authority.
* Document commitments and confirm completion through customer delivery.
* Keep the President informed through frequent, concise updates and priority discussions.
* Clearly hand off unresolved issues requiring attention after your workday ends.

Project-related support

* Assist with sourcing, purchasing follow-ups, and documentation needed to move assigned jobs forward.
* Coordinate resolution of supplier account or administrative issues affecting project schedules.
* Take on other defined projects as agreed with the President, with priorities adjusted to match available capacity.

How responsibilities fit together

Procurement owns purchasing records and supplier purchasing activity. Receiving owns receiving records and material discrepancies. Production owns its schedule and execution.

You own the integrated job dashboard, cross-team follow-through, and coordination through customer delivery. You’ll work with these team members to identify risks, evaluate their recommendations, and drive next steps.

You’ll have the President’s backing to request timely updates, establish action deadlines with the team, and escalate unresolved commitments. Functional leads remain accountable for execution within their areas.

The President resolves competing customer priorities, significant escalations, and decisions beyond your authority. Customer delivery takes priority over additional internal projects.

What we’re looking for

* Evidence of taking responsibility and seeing work through completion.
* Strong organization across multiple tasks, deadlines, and changing priorities.
* Resourcefulness when information is missing or instructions are incomplete.
* Willingness to ask questions, learn from feedback, and apply what you learn.
* Confidence following up with experienced teammates, suppliers, and customers.
* Clear written and verbal communication.
* Attention to detail with dates, quantities, part numbers, documents, and records.
* Judgment about when to act, when to seek input, and when to escalate.
* Comfort working with spreadsheets, shared trackers, email, and business software.
* A collaborative approach and dependable follow-through without repeated reminders.

Relevant experience may come from project coordination, administration, purchasing, logistics, retail, hospitality, or other responsibilities requiring organization and owne

jobs.title: Service Delivery Manager - Santa Clara, CA - HQ
jobs.description:
Service Delivery Manager

Location: Santa Clara, CA

**Position Overview**

The Service Delivery Manager (SDM) is responsible for managing the successful delivery, deployment, and activation of Nile's networking solutions across an assigned portfolio of enterprise customers.

This role serves as the primary technical project manager, coordinating internal engineering teams, deployment resources, third-party partners, logistics, and customer stakeholders to ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope, and in accordance with Nile's delivery standards.

The SDM owns the customer deployment experience from project initiation through implementation, activation, stabilization, and formal handoff to the Customer Success organization.

The ideal candidate combines strong project and program management capabilities with technical networking knowledge, customer-facing leadership, and the ability to drive execution in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. End-to-End Service Delivery Management**

* Own end-to-end delivery execution for assigned customer deployments, ensuring projects are delivered on schedule, within scope, and according to established quality standards.
* Lead customer onboarding and deployment activities from project kickoff through implementation, activation, and operational handoff.
* Develop and maintain detailed project plans, milestones, resource requirements, dependencies, and delivery schedules.
* Establish clear ownership, accountability, and communication across all delivery workstreams.
* Proactively identify delivery risks, dependencies, and potential blockers, implementing mitigation plans before they impact customer outcomes.
* Manage multiple concurrent customer deployments across different geographies and levels of complexity.

**2. Customer Engagement and Stakeholder Management**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for customers throughout the deployment and implementation lifecycle.
* Lead project kickoff meetings, status reviews, technical workshops, and executive-level project updates.
* Set clear customer expectations around timelines, responsibilities, prerequisites, and deployment scope.
* Build strong relationships with customer IT leadership, project managers, technical teams, and business stakeholders.
* Proactively manage customer escalations and drive timely resolution in collaboration with internal teams.
* Ensure a positive, transparent, and consistent customer experience throughout the deployment journey.

**3. Cross-Functional Team Coordination**

* Coordinate closely with Sales, Solutions Engineering, Solutions Architecture, Service Engineering, Network Engineering, Product, Support, and Customer Success.
* Ensure appropriate technical discovery, design validation, and Bill of Materials (BoM) signoff before deployment execution.
* Work with Service Delivery Engineers (SDEs), deployment engineers, and external partners to coordinate implementation activities.
* Ensure alignment between pre-sales commitments and delivery execution.
* Drive effective collaboration between Day 0/Day 1 delivery teams and Day 2 Customer Success and Support teams.
* Identify organizational gaps and improve cross-functional processes to minimize handoff issues and operational friction.

**4. Deployment and Partner Management**

* Coordinate deployment resources, including field technicians, installation partners, cabling vendors, and logistics providers.
* Ensure deployment partners meet Nile's technical, operational, and customer experience standards.
* Validate site readiness, equipment availability, shipping schedules, installation requirements, and deployment prerequisites.
* Monitor partner performance, quality of work, productivity, and adherence to deployment schedules.
* Drive corrective actions when partner performance or deployment quality falls below expectations.
* Maintain consistent deployment processes and execution standards across regions.

**5. Operational Excellence and Process Improvement**

* Establish and maintain standardized deployment methodologies, project templates, delivery playbooks, and operational procedures.
* Drive continuous improvement across project execution, customer communications, resource utilization, and deployment efficiency.
* Identify opportunities to automate repetitive processes and improve delivery visibility through tools such as Jira and Nile's internal platforms.
* Develop scalable delivery practices that support Nile's growing customer base and global NaaS business.
* Maintain accurate project documentation, deployment records, risk registers, and customer acceptance documentation.
* Drive lessons-learned reviews and incorporate feedback into future delivery improvements.

**6. Customer Handoff and Day 2 Readiness**

* Ensure all deployment activities are completed and validated before customer handoff.
* Coordinate operational transition from Service Delivery to Customer Success, Customer Support, and Technical Account Management teams.
* Ensure customer environments are properly documented, configured, tested, and ready for ongoing operations.
* Conduct handoff meetings covering network architecture, deployment status, known issues, open actions, and operational considerations.
* Ensure outstanding deployment issues are tracked with clear ownership and resolution timelines.
* Support early-life stabilization and hypercare activities to ensure a smooth transition into steady-state operations.

**7. Reporting, Governance, and Performance Management**

* Provide regular project and portfolio updates to Service Delivery leadership.
* Maintain visibility into project health, milestones, resource requirements, risks, and customer satisfaction.
* Establish and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) for delivery execution and customer experience.
* Drive accountability across internal teams and external partners.
* Escalate critical delivery risks and customer-impacting issues th

jobs.title: Project Manager - Commercial Plumbing & Process Piping
jobs.description:
An established commercial plumbing and mechanical contractor in the San Jose area is seeking an experienced MEP Project Manager to lead commercial and industrial plumbing and process piping projects from preconstruction through final closeout. The ideal candidate has a strong plumbing construction background and knows how to lead project teams, control costs, hold schedules, and deliver successful projects.

This role requires hands-on project ownership, strong technical knowledge of plumbing systems, and the ability to coordinate field operations, subcontractors, vendors, and client relationships while protecting quality, safety, and profitability.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Plan, schedule, budget, and manage commercial plumbing and process piping projects from preconstruction through completion.
* Direct field crews, subcontractors, and vendors to maintain productivity, installation quality, jobsite safety, and schedules.
* Review drawings, specifications, submittals, RFIs, and change orders to resolve technical issues and scope discrepancies.
* Coordinate procurement, material deliveries, equipment, and field resources.
* Monitor budgets, job costs, billing, and change orders to protect financial performance.
* Work closely with general contractors, engineers, clients, and inspectors to resolve challenges and keep communication clear.
* Lead project meetings and track progress against schedules, budgets, and milestones.
* Coordinate inspections, system commissioning, punch lists, and closeout to meet all contractual requirements.
* Identify project risks early and implement solutions to prevent delays, cost overruns, and field disruptions.

  
**Requirements**  

* 5+ years of project management experience in commercial or industrial plumbing construction.
* Proven experience managing commercial plumbing and/or process piping projects.
* Prior experience with a plumbing contractor, mechanical contractor, or MEP subcontractor.
* Strong knowledge of plumbing systems, construction drawings, specifications, and installation methods.
* Experience managing schedules, budgets, procurement, RFIs, submittals, change orders, and subcontractors.
* Ability to take full ownership of projects from preconstruction through completion.
* Strong leadership, communication, problem-solving, and client relationship skills.
* Ability to coordinate multiple project activities while meeting schedule and budget commitments.

**Please Note:** Direct project management experience in commercial or industrial plumbing construction is required. Residential-only backgrounds, or experience limited to MEP coordination or administrative support, will not qualify.

 **Benefits**  

* Competitive base salary commensurate with experience.
* Health insurance options.
* Retirement plan options.
* Paid time off.
* Additional company-sponsored benefits.

jobs.title: Planning Associate I-II (Project Manager)
jobs.description:
### **Description**

Alta Planning + Design seeks a **Planning Associate (I-II)** for **Oakland**. This mid- to senior-level position is a great opportunity for someone who believes in the importance of multimodal transportation and who is interested in growing their career as a transportation planning professional. If you are looking to join an innovative organization and do work that connects people to places while advancing social justice, safety, and environmental resilience, apply with Alta today!  
  
**About Alta**  
Alta is a mission-driven company working to mitigate climate change and advance safety and social justice by shaping sustainable, people-centered communities. We bring together expertise across planning, design, engineering, education and encouragement programs, and community engagement to help communities thrive. Our work is grounded in the belief that how places are designed and experienced has a profound impact on equity, health, and opportunity—and that people should always be at the heart of those decisions.

Founded in 1996, Alta was at the forefront of the active transportation movement and has spent nearly 30 years partnering with communities to imagine a more connected, resilient, and inclusive future. Today, with more than 225 staff across the United States and beyond, we are a global leader in creating environments that support everyday life, strengthen human connection, and respond to the challenges of a changing world. Alta offers the opportunity to collaborate across disciplines, contribute to meaningful work at every scale, and be part of a team committed to making lasting, positive change for people and the places they call home.

### **Day to Day**

In this role, you’ll have the opportunity to lead and directly influence a wide variety of active, multimodal, and sustainable transportation projects including safety plans, active transportation plans, and on-street designs. You will engage residents, attend site visits and charettes, identify and communicate opportunities to improve walking and biking networks and work on complete street projects. You will have the opportunity to work with and learn from an interdisciplinary team of dedicated professionals from across the company who have pioneered active transportation in the US, and have contributed to national best practices around facility design.  
  
The essential priorities of this exempt, salaried position are to:

* Nurture and grow client and industry partner relationships, pursue and secure work in support of Alta’s growth goals.
* Enhance Alta’s reputation as a trusted advisor and expert by educating clients and other relevant parties and supporting solutions that will meet their business objectives.
* Appropriately manage large, complex projects in a budget-conscious and time-sensitive manner.
* Manage staff

  

### **Qualifications**

**Required**  
  
This position requires a combination of skills, experience and education including, but not limited to

* Bachelor’s degree in Planning or a related field of study.
* 7+ years of experience in a consulting environment or public entity
* 2+ years as a project manager, including managing project teams, and conducting business development activities
* Experience in the field of active, non-motorized and multimodal transportation.
* Demonstrated understanding of the planning process and a general understanding of project management principles, methods and techniques.
* Ability to guide staff members and manage internal team expectations.
* Strong initiative and ability to capitalize on opportunities to enhance Alta’s position in the marketplace.
* Ability to manage competing priorities, and multiple simultaneous projects involving cross-functional project teams within budgetary and schedule constraints.
* Strong initiative and the ability to work independently with little or no supervision.
* Ability and willingness to travel.
* Excellent professional ethics, leadership skills, accountability, and decision-making capabilities.
* Excellent interpersonal, written, and verbal communication and analytic skills.
* Good presentation skills.
* Proficient in MS Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Adobe Illustrator, InDesign, Arc GIS, or similar products and Google Workspace Apps.
* Proficiency in an enterprise-wide resource planning and project management tool.

There are a number of additional skills, experience, and education that would be beneficial to this position including, but not limited to:

* Master’s Degree in Urban Planning or similar field
* Experience managing large transportation related projects for both private and public clients.
* Experience writing and/or presenting white papers and/or providing expert level presentations at conferences and other events promoting the field of sustainable infrastructure and active, non-motorized transportation.
* Active participation in industry-relevant professional associations and committees
* AICP, RSP, or CP3 Certification.
* Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering or experience as a Transportation Engineer a plus!

  

### **What We Offer**

**Flexible Schedule**

Alta offers a flexible, hybrid work schedule where most employees work from home three days per week. In-office days support our collaborative culture, one of our core values.  
  
**Compensation**

The base salary range for this role is indicated in the posting. This range reflects the company’s good faith estimate of the compensation for this position at the time of posting. Final compensation will be determined based on factors such as experience, skills, qualifications, internal equity, and geographic location.

**Benefits**

Alta offers comprehensive benefits to all full-time employees:

* **Medical**: PPO or HSA medical plans
* **Dental/Vision**: PPO
* **Life Insurance**: Alta pays 100% of the premium for life and AD&D, equal to your base compensation
* **401(k)**: Alta provides a match up to 3%
* **PTO**: 21 days accrued annually to start
