**LOCATION:** Concord

The Regional Center of the East Bay (RCEB) is one of 21 Regional Centers that are community-based, private non-profit corporations under contract with the California Department of Developmental Services. RCEB provides intake, assessment, diagnosis, and coordinates community-based services for over 25,000 children and adults with developmental disabilities in Alameda and Contra Costa counties.

RCEB envisions a future where persons with developmental disabilities are truly a part of the community. Persons with developmental disabilities receive supports and services they need to succeed. The supports and services change as the need changes.

In our dream, children with developmental disabilities live with families in typical communities. Many choose to attend their neighborhood schools and play with neighborhood friends. Adults with developmental disabilities live in the residence of their choice – with family members, with friends, or with their spouse / significant other. They engage in activities of their choice – work, volunteering, education, training, or leisure. They have meaningful relationships with friends and coworkers and are seen as valuable, contributing members of their communities.

**Title: Supplier Quality Manager (Quality Systems)**

Location: South San Francisco, CA

Work Type: On-site

Salary Range: $140,000 - $150,000

Neurona Therapeutics is a clinical stage biotechnology company based in South San Francisco focused on the development of neuronal cell-based therapies for neurological diseases. Our ideal candidate is a self-motivated individual who has a passion for quality. This is a fantastic opportunity to join a growing team, and take part in building an exciting, science-driven company.  
  
**The Role:**  
Neurona is seeking a Supplier Quality Manager who is responsible for the development, implementation, execution, and continuous improvement of Neurona Therapeutics’ Supplier Quality Management program. Reporting to the Director, QA Systems, this individual provides Quality oversight of GxP suppliers, vendors, service providers, contract organizations, and other external partners supporting the development and manufacture of Neurona’s cell therapy products.  
  
The Supplier Quality Manager serves as the Quality Systems subject matter expert for supplier qualification, risk assessment, supplier audits, quality agreements, ongoing performance monitoring, Supplier Corrective Action Requests (SCARs), and periodic requalification. This role partners closely with Quality, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Technical Operations, CMC, Clinical, Information Technology, and other functions to ensure externally provided materials and services meet Neurona requirements and applicable regulatory expectations.  
  
This position combines program ownership with hands-on execution and is expected to build a scalable, risk-based supplier quality program appropriate for a growing clinical-stage cell therapy organization.  
  
**Essential Duties and Responsibilities Include:**  
**Supplier Qualification and Lifecycle Management**

* Own and administer the GxP supplier and vendor qualification program in accordance with applicable Neurona procedures and regulatory requirements.
* Lead the risk-based assessment, qualification, approval, monitoring, requalification, and disqualification of suppliers.
* Review and approve supplier qualification questionnaires and supporting documentation.
* Assess supplier quality systems, technical capabilities, compliance history, and potential risk to product quality, patient safety, data integrity, and regulatory compliance.
* Establish qualification requirements based on supplier type, criticality, intended use, and GxP risk.
* Ensure qualification decisions and supporting documentation are complete, traceable, and inspection ready.
* Maintain supplier qualification status and applicable records in the electronic Quality Management System, including the Approved Vendor List.

**Supplier Audits**

* Support the development and maintenance of a risk-based supplier audit program and audit schedule.
* Support planning, conducting, and documenting on-site, remote, and qualification audits of GxP suppliers and service providers.
* Support regulatory inspections and partner audits involving supplier oversight.

**Supplier Quality Agreements**

* Lead the preparation, review, negotiation, approval, maintenance, and periodic review of GxP Quality Agreements.
* Ensure Quality Agreements clearly define responsibilities for deviations, investigations, CAPAs, change notification, complaints, data integrity, records, audits, subcontracting, regulatory inspections, and other applicable quality requirements.
* Partner with Legal, Supply Chain, CMC, Manufacturing, Clinical, IT, and other functions to establish appropriate provisions.
* Monitor supplier compliance with established Quality Agreement requirements.

**Supplier Performance Management**

* Develop and maintain a risk-based supplier performance monitoring and scorecard program.
* Establish meaningful KPIs and quality metrics for critical suppliers.
* Monitor performance across SCARs, audit findings, deviations and quality events, CAPA effectiveness, change notifications, responsiveness, recurring issues, delivery of quality commitments, and compliance with Quality Agreements.
* Conduct periodic supplier performance reviews and communicate trends, risks, and recommendations to Quality leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.
* Identify suppliers requiring enhanced oversight or formal improvement plans.
* Present supplier quality trends and significant risks during Quality Management Review and other governance forums.

**Supplier Corrective Action and Escalation**

* Lead or coordinate Supplier Corrective Action Requests for significant supplier quality issues.
* Ensure appropriate containment, investigation, root cause analysis, corrective and preventive actions, and effectiveness verification.
* Assess supplier investigation and CAPA responses for scientific and technical adequacy.
* Identify recurring issues and escalate significant quality, compliance, supply continuity, or patient-risk concerns.
* Facilitate cross-functional supplier quality escalation meetings, as necessary.
* Partner with suppliers to drive sustainable improvement rather than relying solely on correction or retraining.

**Quality Systems and Compliance**

* Ensure supplier quality activities are conducted in accordance with applicable GxP requirements, company procedures, and Quality Agreements.
* Integrate Supplier Quality with deviations, CAPA, change control, document control, training, Quality Management Review, and other QMS processes.
* Evaluate supplier-related changes for potential impact to product quality, process performance, validated state, regulatory commitments, and supply continuity.
* Develop and revise Supplier Quality procedures, forms, templates, risk-assessment tools, metrics, and training materials.
* Maintain supplier quality records in an inspection-ready state.
* Support internal audits, partner audits, due diligence activities, and regulatory inspections involving supplier oversight.

jobs.title: Learning & Development Manager
jobs.description:
**About Mytra:**

We’re creating an entirely new way to solve the most ubiquitous problem in industry - moving and storing material. We’re applying robotics and distributed software to create a new class of product for this $1T market. We’re focused on the supply chain industry first. The industry is in a massive bind with the continued growth of e-commerce, sharp rise in costs, and supply chain disruptions. What has been a “sleepy” industry for decades is now at the epicenter of sustaining the global economy.

**About the role**
------------------

As a Learning & Development Lead at Mytra, you will join our People team during a period of rapid scaling. You will build Mytra’s first dedicated learning function: programs that grow our employees and leaders, keep Mytra safe and compliant, and give our customers the training they need to run our system. We need a hands-on, systems-minded builder to help us turn learning into a driver of capability and growth.

**What you’ll do:**
-------------------

* **Build a foundational learning function.** Set structured standards for how training is designed and delivered at Mytra, create learning pathways mapped to the Mytra Level Matrix, and develop train-the-trainer programs to scale expertise across teams
* **Own employee development.** Partner with the People team on new hire orientation and onboarding, run feedback training, and design ongoing learning programs and stipends
* **Run leadership development programs.** Partner with the Head of People to curate programs for our leaders, including Enneagram sessions and people manager training. Own the operations behind them: managing external coaches and vendors, managing attendees and enrollment, and supporting facilitators with content grounded in adult learning principles
* **Drive customer enablement.** Work with Deployment, Sustainment, Customer Operations and Safety so customers have the right training and a clean handoff after deployment, covering on-the-job training, processes, escalations and system safety
* **Build on-the-job training.** Partner with Manufacturing, Safety and Customer Operations to develop critical training that ramps internal capability, including effective train-the-trainer programs for technical and frontline teams
* **Own the LMS and training compliance.** Manage our LMS for all Mytra training, and partner cross-functionally to deliver 100% compliance on safety, security and HR-related training

**Ideal Candidates**
--------------------

* Have proven experience designing and scaling learning programs across employee, leadership and technical or operational training
* Have deep expertise in adult learning principles and instructional design, with a track record of turning them into practical, engaging content
* Have built learning structures from the ground up, including standards, pathways and measurement, ideally in a fast-growing company
* Have built train-the-trainer and on-the-job programs in hardware, manufacturing or field-based environments
* Have run the operations of learning programs: LMS administration, compliance tracking, and managing external coaches and vendors
* Operate with high independence: define the approach for ambiguous initiatives, make tradeoffs across operational and business needs, and build practices adopted well beyond your own team

**Nice to have:**

* Customer training or enablement experience for complex hardware or software products
* Enneagram certification

**A Final Note:**

If this role excites you, we encourage you to apply — even if you don’t check every box. At Mytra, we build bots, but we hire humans. We value thoughtful challengers who communicate with clarity and respect, and we’re lifelong learners committed to getting better every day. We move fast, learn faster, and show up for each other under pressure. The best outcomes come from diverse perspectives working together to build something meaningful and built to last

* Lively, modern combined office and lab space where we rapidly iterate through design, build, and test phases

jobs.title: Operations Associate
jobs.description:
**Company**
-----------

Pramaana Labs is a frontier AI lab building the verification layer for AI. Founded in 2025 and headquartered in Palo Alto, we turn complex human knowledge, including tax codes, legal rules, clinical guidelines and security protocols, into formal representations so AI answers can be traced, challenged and proved. Our architecture pairs foundation models trained to formalize and reason with a symbolic world model encoded in Lean 4. Pramaana was founded by a team from Google, DeepMind and Glean, bringing together frontier AI researchers and formal methods experts. Our commercial team is building the go-to-market motion to bring this technology to enterprises where correctness matters most.

**The Role**
------------

At a fast-moving research company, small execution gaps can slow down important work. We are looking for an Operations Associate who makes the company run better: someone who anticipates needs, creates order in ambiguity, communicates thoughtfully and closes loops without needing to be chased. You will partner closely with the Chief of Staff and work across recruiting, commercial operations and broader company priorities. One day may involve coordinating a high-stakes customer meeting; another, improving an interview process, supporting a team event or owning an operational project from start to finish. This is a high-trust, hands-on role with room to grow into increasingly independent ownership.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Keep critical external engagements moving: coordinate customer and partner meetings, prepare participants, track follow-ups and ensure every commitment has an owner and next step.
* Own an excellent candidate experience through interview scheduling, interviewer coordination, confirmations, reschedules, clear communications and accurate ATS updates.
* Support daily company operations such as team events, visitors, vendors, office logistics, documentation and lightweight purchasing coordination as needs arise.
* Build simple, reliable trackers for priorities, deadlines, decisions and cross-functional dependencies; surface conflicts early instead of allowing silent slippage.
* Prepare crisp agendas, briefs, meeting notes and status updates so leaders enter conversations prepared and leave with actionable decisions.
* Spot recurring friction, improve checklists and templates, and implement lightweight automation rather than repeating avoidable manual work.
* Handle confidential people and commercial information with judgment, warmth and discretion; take ownership of increasingly complex projects as you earn trust.

**You Will Thrive in This Role If You Have**
--------------------------------------------

* Outstanding organization, attention to detail and follow-through, including the ability to manage simultaneous time-sensitive work without dropping commitments.
* Excellent written communication and stakeholder judgment with executives, candidates, customers and vendors.
* Comfort coordinating calendars across time zones, working in Google Workspace and spreadsheets, and learning systems such as Ashby and HubSpot.
* A service mindset without passivity: you anticipate problems, ask the right questions, propose fixes and communicate risks early.
* Resilience and calm under shifting priorities, plus the ability to decide when to act independently and when to escalate.
* Curiosity about how a company is built and enthusiasm for improving systems, not only completing individual tasks.

**Especially Strong Candidates May Also Have**
----------------------------------------------

* Experience in recruiting coordination, executive operations, sales coordination, workplace operations or a fast-growing startup.
* Built a scheduling or operating workflow that reduced errors, improved response times or made stakeholders meaningfully more effective.
* Familiarity with Ashby, HubSpot, workflow automation, vendor coordination or internal-event execution.

jobs.title: Customer Service Operations Specialist
jobs.description:
**About Q’Apel:**

At Q’Apel, we are passionate about revolutionizing neurovascular access. In the simplest sense, we’re a company that creates solutions. We design novel access device technology for vascular interventions and unmet clinical needs. Because in the precious seconds that surround a stroke emergency, clinicians need technology that delivers. That’s where Q’Apel comes in. Successful Q’Apel team members step up to the plate and work together to achieve our goals every single day. We are a fast paced, high growth company with a startup philosophy which requires an all-hands-on-deck attitude, taking on all changes with excitement and a great attitude.

**Who We Want:**

We are seeking an experienced, highly organized, and detail-oriented Customer Service Operations Specialist to add depth and stability to our Customer Service team. This role handles everything from day-to-day order entry to complex, time-consuming, domestic and international import/export procedures, including export documentation, distributor shipments, and 3PL (thirdparty logistics) transactions.

The ideal candidate is a self-driven professional who thrives in a fast-paced environment, adapts easily to evolving processes, and takes initiative without waiting to be asked. They can see the big picture, translate company-wide needs into department-level tasks, and recommend improvements. They communicate effectively with headquarters staff, the sales team, customer support, production, quality, and finance to support order fulfillment, billing, inventory reconciliation,

and complaint resolution.

**What You’ll Work On:**

**Order Entry & Processing:**

* Perform accurate, timely order entry for domestic and international customers in NetSuite and Salesforce.
* Handle routine daily tasks alongside complex, detailed, and time-consuming procedures with the same level of care.
* Process international import and export orders, following all required steps and documentation.

**Export & International Logistics:**

* Prepare and manage export documentation to ensure compliance with international regulations.
* Coordinate distributor shipments and ensure timely delivery of international orders.
* Oversee 3PL shipment transactions and maintain accurate records of inventory movements.

**Customer Support & Communication:**

* Serve as a main point of contact for international customers, providing exceptional service, professional phone etiquette, and consistent follow-up.
* Communicate clearly with internal headquarters staff and with external sales and customer support teams.
* Collaborate with the sales team to address us customer and distributor inquiries and resolve shipment issues.
* Work with production to ensure stock fulfillment and communicate any delays to customers.

**Operations & Inventory Management:**

* Partner with the quality team to handle product complaints, returns, and replacements.
* Assist finance with billing transactions and ensure 3PL inventory reconciliation is accurate.
* Maintain records and provide reports on order fulfillment, backorders, and stock availability.

**Process Improvement & Team Leadership:**

* Take initiative to start and complete projects without waiting for direction.
* Review processes with a big-picture view and recommend enhancements or improvements.
* Break down company-wide needs into clear department-level requests and tasks.
* Support training and development when new systems, tools, or procedures are introduced.
* Adapt quickly to evolving processes and procedures and help teammates do the same.

**What You Bring:**

* Experience: 4+ years in customer service, order entry, logistics, or export documentation, including some international import/export order processing. Experience in handling complex, detailed procedures is required.
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Supply Chain, International Trade, or a related field preferred.
* Technical Skills: Hands-on experience with NetSuite and/or Salesforce (or similar ERP/CRM software). Medium to high proficiency in Excel, plus Microsoft Office (Word, Outlook), Adobe, various shipping portals, and familiarity with 3PL processes.
* Systems Training: Some experience training others on, or helping roll out, new systems or processes.
* Communication: Strong verbal and written communication skills and good phone etiquette.

Able to work with international clients, headquarters staff, sales, customer support, cross departmental teams, and various levels of leadership.

* Detail-Oriented & Organized: Able to manage multiple tasks, ensure document accuracy, plan proactively, and stay on top of timelines in a fast-paced environment.
* Adaptable & Focused: Comfortable with evolving and changing processes and procedures; able to stay focused and get objectives done.
* Self-Driven Leader: Takes ownership and initiative, does not wait to be told to start or finish a project, and sees the big picture.
* Team Player: Flexible, supportive, and collaborative attitude in a team environment.
* Problem-Solving: Proactive approach to resolving order issues, customer concerns, and logistics challenges.

Our compensation ranges are calculated by role and level. Your position within that range will be determined by your job-related knowledge, skills, experience, relevant education, and training/certifications. After you join the company your performance, contributions, and results along with business and organizational needs will affect your compensation. The base salary range for this full-time, exempt position is between $75,000 - $85,000.

jobs.title: Global People Operations Partner
jobs.description:
### **THE COMPANY**

Saildrone is a maritime defense company and the global leader in autonomous unmanned surface vehicles (USVs). With more ocean miles and real-world operational experience than any USV manufacturer or operator, Saildrone maintains active, combat-deployed systems supporting national security and force projection around the world, 24/7/365.

Saildrone's manufacturing and R&D headquarters are located in Alameda, CA, with business development and sales operations in Washington, DC, an established European entity supporting regional business development, sales, and operations, and a deployment hub in the Middle East. By combining proven autonomous operations, edge computing, advanced sensing, renewable power, and the most advanced and robust unmanned surface technology on the planet, Saildrone is shaping how the Navy of the future operates. Join a fast-moving, mission-driven team at the forefront of maritime security and autonomous innovation.

### **THE POSITION**

Saildrone is seeking a Staff Global People Ops Partner to join our People Operations team. Reporting directly to the Director, People Ops & Total Rewards, you will play a critical role in integrating newly established international entities with HQ systems and spearheading the People Operations buildout for emerging regions worldwide. We are looking for a global compliance expert who can act as the crucial bridge between our external Employer of Record (EOR) partners and our internal Recruiting and Operations teams, ensuring strict adherence to international employment laws, US export controls, and regional mandates.

### **THE TEAM**

The People Operations team is responsible for driving the people strategy that enables Saildrone to scale globally. We are focused on establishing scalable, culturally integrated, and legally compliant international employment frameworks to support the rapid deployment of our autonomous platforms, operating in a complex maritime and defense environment.

### **THE RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Lead the People Operations strategy for emerging markets across various global regions, driving local recruitment frameworks, culturally and legally compliant benefits packages, and strict adherence to regional labor laws.
* Serve as the bridge between international entities and Alameda HQ, standardizing HRIS, payroll, and performance management systems while designing robust onboarding and training programs that weave global employees into the core Saildrone culture.
* Act as the primary compliance authority for all hiring executed through Employer of Record (EOR) partners, ensuring all contracts correctly classify workers and adhere to local labor laws to mitigate misclassification risks.
* Partner closely with the Recruiting team to seamlessly integrate EOR solutions into the talent acquisition process, advising recruiters on legal and compliance requirements for specific regions prior to extending offers.
* Oversee the compliance framework for transitioning international independent contractors to EOR employees where local regulations require it, ensuring all liability and insurance requirements are met.
* Own the end-to-end immigration lifecycle for global transfers and localized hires, partnering with external counsel to expedite work visas in high-stakes regions. Partner with Legal to build robust screening processes for international applicants and EOR hires, ensuring strict compliance with U.S. export controls (ITAR/EAR) regarding technology access for foreign nationals.
* Partner with consultants to navigate employing seafarers operating in international waters, ensure alignment with international maritime labor conventions and regional maritime law, and manage specialized expatriate and maritime medical plans.

### **THE QUALIFICATIONS**

* 10+ years of progressive experience in Global People Operations, Global Mobility, or International HR Compliance within a rapidly scaling hardware, defense, or maritime technology company.
* Deep expertise in the legal and compliance structures of Employer of Record platforms, with a strong ability to partner with Recruiting to execute international hires safely and legally.
* Proven track record of executing HR operations and establishing new entities in diverse international markets, with specific knowledge of regional work authorizations and labor laws.
* Demonstrated ability to integrate international subsidiaries into U.S.-headquartered ecosystems, focusing on both system architecture (HRIS/payroll) and cultural alignment (onboarding/training).
* Strong working knowledge of U.S. export control regulations (ITAR/EAR) as they pertain to global hiring and technology transfer.
* Experience managing employment frameworks for maritime personnel, offshore workers, or commercial seafarers is highly preferred.
* Exceptional cross-cultural communication skills, with the ability to translate complex regulatory constraints into actionable business strategies for hiring managers.

### **PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS**

* Ability to work 5 days per week in office at Alameda headquarters.
* Must be willing to travel domestically and internationally 10-25% of the time.

To view Saildrone's candidate privacy policy, please visit: https://www.saildrone.com/privacy-policy.

### **BENEFITS**

At Saildrone, we're building operational capability that matters—and that requires people who can do their best work over the long term. We invest in our team's well-being, financial security, and professional growth so you can focus on delivering real-world impact with confidence and stability. Our comprehensive benefits package is designed to support you and your family while you contribute to a mission with lasting significance.

* **Generous Time Off:** Competitive Paid Time Off (PTO) accrual plus a robust annual holiday schedule and paid sick leave ensure you can rest, reset, and sustain performance over time.
* **Comprehensive Health Coverage:** Premium, multi-tier Medical, Dental

jobs.title: Compliance / Training Specialist
jobs.description:
**Compliance / Training Specialist**  
**Yogurtland | Field-Based Position**  
**Location:** Northern & Southern California

**About the Opportunity**

Yogurtland is seeking a detail-oriented Compliance / Training Specialist who is passionate about food safety, operational excellence, and helping store teams succeed.

This role combines objective store evaluations with practical, hands-on training. You will visit franchise locations, assess execution against Yogurtland standards, identify opportunities for improvement, and help franchisees, managers, and team members understand how to correct issues and sustain results.

The ideal candidate can hold teams accountable while building respectful, productive relationships. You should be comfortable explaining the “why” behind a standard, addressing difficult conversations professionally, and following through until corrective actions are verified.

**What You’ll Do**

**Store Compliance and Brand Standards**

* Conduct thorough, objective audits of assigned locations, evaluating food safety, sanitation, product quality, equipment, facility conditions, guest experience, and brand standards.
* Verify actual store conditions through direct observation, measurements, records, and required photographs.
* Evaluate frozen yogurt and topping quality, including freshness, taste, texture, temperature controls, and product testing using approved procedures.
* Apply audit standards and severity classifications consistently across all locations.
* Prepare accurate, timely reports with clear findings, supporting evidence, and required corrective actions.
* Promptly address and escalate serious food safety, employee or guest safety, product integrity, and repeated compliance concerns.

**Training and Store Team Development**

* Provide hands-on instruction to franchisees, managers, and team members on approved operating procedures and brand expectations.
* Reinforce proper food handling, allergen controls, sanitation, product preparation, quality checks, and equipment care.
* Explain audit findings clearly and demonstrate corrective practices when appropriate.
* Identify gaps in knowledge or execution and recommend targeted training to Operations leadership.
* Partner with Franchise Business Consultants and Operations to support lasting improvements and consistent communication.
* Participate in team training and audit calibration exercises to ensure standards are interpreted and applied consistently.

**Corrective Action and Follow-Through**

* Conduct professional closing conversations that clarify findings, priorities, next steps, and follow-up expectations.
* Track outstanding corrective actions and verify completion through approved documentation or follow-up visits.
* Identify recurring issues and escalate unresolved concerns through the appropriate Operations channels.
* Maintain objective audit results while documenting corrections and training provided during the visit.
* Share trends and recommendations that can improve training, operating procedures, and systemwide execution.

**Field Planning and Reporting**

* Plan efficient travel routes and visit schedules to support consistent territory coverage.
* Maintain a regular field presence, with five days per week in stores except for approved or extenuating circumstances.
* Target a minimum of two completed audits per field day when routing and circumstances reasonably permit, while maintaining thorough evaluations.
* Keep audit documentation, corrective-action tracking, and leadership updates current.
* Protect confidential franchisee, employee, and business information.

**What You Bring**

* Experience in restaurant operations, preferably within quick-service, fast-casual, or franchise environments.
* A strong understanding of food safety, sanitation, product quality, and store operating standards.
* Experience coaching or training restaurant managers and team members.
* Strong observation, documentation, organization, and follow-through skills.
* The ability to communicate expectations clearly and handle disagreement calmly and professionally.
* Sound judgment and the ability to remain fair, consistent, and objective.
* Comfort using digital audit platforms, mobile devices, reporting tools, and spreadsheets.
* The ability to manage an assigned territory independently and travel regularly to store locations.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience conducting operational audits, food safety inspections, or brand compliance evaluations.
* Experience supporting multiple locations or working directly with franchisees.
* Current food protection manager certification, such as ServSafe or an equivalent credential.
* Experience with frozen dessert operations or related foodservice equipment.

**What Success Looks Like**

Success in this role means accurate audits, clear and useful training, timely corrective-action closure, fewer repeat findings, and stronger execution across assigned stores. We value both accountability and the ability to help teams understand and consistently meet expectations.

**How to Apply**

Submit your resume to arlo.mcguire@yogurtland.com . Please highlight your experience in restaurant operations, compliance, food safety, and team training and your location.

Pay: $60,000.00 - $70,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Customer Success Project Manager
jobs.description:
Amid clinical workforce shortages, rising healthcare costs, and ongoing concerns about inequity, IMPaCT unlocks the power of the grassroots community health workforce.

Here at IMPaCT Care (https://impactcarehq.com/), we get out of bed every day to change lives, with the most effective intervention in the world for addressing health inequity. We find, train and enable Community Health Workers to make magic: caring people who keep their communities healthy. We have built the largest and most scientifically proven Community Health Worker platform in the country, used across 22 states by 70+ organizations like Kaiser Permanente, CVS and United Way. Across multiple randomized controlled trials (https://impactcarehq.com/published-research/), IMPaCT has achieved outcomes frequently believed to be out of reach, including $2,500 in annual savings per patient, improved mental health and a Net Promoter Score of 94. There is even a new Medicare billing code for Community Health Workers that is modeled after IMPaCT!

We are changing the game, but also know the importance of enjoying the journey. We provide competitive compensation and equity grants, comprehensive benefits and plenty of opportunities for team building and fun. Plus you get to work from home.

Curious? Read on.

### **Who You Are**

You are the person who keeps the plan. When 6 people are talking at once on a customer call about data files, go-live dates and who owns what, you are already typing the action items, assigning owners and setting due dates. By the time the call ends, your recap is ready to send.

* **An air traffic controller:** you run a 200-task Asana plan across several customers and always know what is landing next.
* **A live capture pro:** you think while you type, and you organize as you go. Notes land in the right place the first time.
* **One step ahead:** like a great surgical tech who hands over the next instrument before anyone asks, you anticipate what the team and the customer will need next.
* **Unafraid of complexity:** Medicare, Medicaid, SFTP, eligibility files. When you hear a term you do not know, you ask, learn it and use it correctly the next time.
* **Warm and professional:** you welcome customers to a call, deliver hard news with calm and kindness, and guide people through change.
* **Here to master the craft:** you love this kind of work and want to grow in it.

### **What You Will Do**

**Run the plan**

* Build project plans that work backward from customer goals, tracking every deliverable, owner and deadline.
* Capture decisions and next steps in real time in Asana and Salesforce (for example, "Per 6/15 discussion, Sunbelt will pilot new workflows by Q3").
* Act as the hub between internal teams (Product, Tech, Workforce Development, Clinical) and hold everyone to the timeline.

**See around corners**

* Spot risks early and flag them before they become blockers.
* Know what to solve on your own and when to escalate.
* Prepare customers for delays and tradeoffs before they become surprises.

**Deliver for customers**

* Partner with a Director of Clinical Strategy to support 4-12 healthcare customers, depending on complexity.
* Coordinate end-to-end Community Health Worker program launches and platform adoption.
* Prepare agendas, decks and quarterly business reviews, and pull customer reports.
* Own the Tech Review process with customer IT and compliance teams.
* Triage a steady flow of email, Slack and customer requests so nothing is missed.

### **What You Bring**

* **Required: a Bachelor's degree and a project management certification (PMP or CAPM).**
* 2+ years managing complex projects, implementations, or operations with external customers or partners.
* A track record of managing concurrent projects with zero dropped balls.
* The ability to turn a long discussion into a 1-page summary executives love.
* Hands-on skill with Asana or a similar tool, the Google suite, Zoom and a CRM such as Salesforce.
* Ability to work primarily during Eastern Time business hours.
* Occasional travel for team retreats and customer site visits.

**Nice to have:** familiarity with U.S. healthcare (health systems, payers, community-based organizations) or experience at a health tech or SaaS startup.

### **Our Hiring Process**

Live note-taking is central to this role, so we test it early. After you apply and answer a few short questions, selected candidates complete a short live note-taking exercise and a screening interview, followed by a project plan exercise and team interviews.

IMPaCT Care is committed to providing an inclusive interview experience. If you need any accommodations to participate fully, please let us know.

*One of our core values is to create a diverse workplace that welcomes and values each team member's unique perspective, background and ideas. We are committed to an inclusive and diverse workplace.*

**Position Title: GGU One Contact Center Operations Manager**

**Department Name: Office of the Provost**

**Position Reports To: Vice Provost of Academic Operations**

**FLSA STATUS: Salaried**

**Salary: $110,000 - $140,000**; this position is eligible for an annual performance-based bonus incentive.

**Benefits:** The University's comprehensive benefits program.

**Location:** Remote; some travel may be required for in-person collaboration and campus events.

**Days & Hours:** Standard work schedule is Monday through Friday, 37.5 hours per week, generally 9am – 5:30pm PST but can be adjusted and/or staggered to support team coverage across the team’s coverage window; flexible schedule may require some evening and weekend hours during peak periods or to handle escalations.

**BASIC FUNCTION AND SCOPE OF JOB:**

Build, stabilize, and lead GGU One’s student support operation. Manage the Navigator team (Navigators are Golden Gate University’s first contact for all student inquiries), establish dependable coverage and follow-up, improve service quality, and lead implementation of the agreed operating model and roadmap in partnership with university departments and IT.

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:**

* **Team Leadership & Development:** Hire, onboard, supervise, coach, and evaluate the GGU One Navigator team. Establish clear responsibilities and ongoing training.
* **Daily Operations & Coverage:** Own staffing schedules, absence coverage, queue monitoring, callback oversight, and daily priorities across phone and email support. Designate backup operational coverage during planned and unplanned absences.
* **Service Implementation & Improvement:** Lead execution of the approved GGU One operating model and roadmap, translating pilot findings into sustainable workflows, staffing practices, and service improvements.
* **Vision & Service Evolution:** Shape the long-term vision for GGU One in partnership with university leadership. Evaluate opportunities to improve student support through AI, self-service, and additional channels such as chat and text, prioritizing student needs, service quality, and operational readiness.
* **Case Ownership & Tier 2 Follow-Through:** Establish clear ownership, response expectations, and escalation procedures with university departments. Monitor unresolved and overdue inquiries, address stalled handoffs, and ensure students receive updates through resolution.
* **Knowledge & Guidance:** Coordinate with departmental subject-matter experts to maintain accurate, approved Navigator resources. Establish content owners and a process for addressing gaps, conflicting guidance, and policy changes.
* **Quality Assurance & Training:** Review call recordings, email interactions, and case documentation. Provide timely coaching and targeted training on accuracy, empathy, identity verification, escalation, and follow-up.
* **Technology & Workflow Coordination:** Partner with IT and Salesforce administrators to improve inquiry management and support the transition from interim Teams and tracker workflows to the approved Salesforce-based approach. Define operational requirements, lead user testing, and prepare the team to adopt new workflows, while technical teams own system configuration and integrations.
* **Reporting & Capacity Planning:** Produce regular reporting on demand, answering, callbacks, resolution, unresolved work, and quality. Validate metric definitions and data accuracy and recommend staffing adjustments as demand and service scope evolve.
* **Other Duties:** As assigned.

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

* **Education Requirement:** Bachelor’s degree in Business, Higher Education, or any other related field from an accredited college or university.
* **Years of Experience:** 5+ years of relevant service-operations experience, including direct supervision of a customer support, contact center, or higher education student-services team.
* **Operational Leadership:** Demonstrated ability to build or stabilize an evolving service operation, establish workflows, manage queue coverage, and lead teams through process and technology changes.
* **Contact Center Management:** Experience with staffing and shift scheduling, quality assurance scorecards, coaching, case management/ticketing systems, and operational reporting.
* **Cross-Departmental Collaboration:** Ability to establish accountability, establish and monitor Service Level Agreements (SLAs), and resolve student service issues across departments, including teams outside the role’s direct reporting line.
* **Technical Aptitude:** Working knowledge of CRM and contact-center tools (ideally Salesforce Education Cloud/Service Cloud), with experience partnering with IT/technical teams on operational implementations.
* **Domain Knowledge:** Higher-education student-services experience, familiarity with FERPA regulations, and knowledge of military-connected and veteran student needs are strongly preferred.
* **Skills and Abilities:**
  + Excellent communication, leadership, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
  + Ability to remain calm under pressure, handle difficult or emotional clients, and manage a busy, high-stakes service department.
  + Proven experience leading a diverse team with varied expertise, including coaching, training, and employee development.
  + Ability to compile and synthesize data from multiple sources into reports and presentations for leadership.
  + Self-directed and able to work effectively with minimal supervision.

Supplemental Information

Our Virtual First model combines the autonomy of a distributed workplace with the power of human connection, creating space for meaningful work and lasting relationships. With a startup mindset and enterprise-level opportunities, we expect Dropbox employees to think critically, stay curious, and use modern tools, including AI, to improve how work gets done. Here, you can be who you are and grow into who you’re meant to be. You own your impact, helping make work more intuitive, joyful, and human for yourself and hundreds of millions of people worldwide. The Dropbox Business Strategy & Operations team unlocks the company's full potential by driving strategic initiatives and promoting operational excellence. Dropbox’s Virtual First way of working is designed to help people do their best work with flexibility, autonomy, and connection. Day to day, teams work remotely with nonlinear schedules and core collaboration hours that support deep focus and individual working styles. Pulley helps the country’s top architects, builders, and retailers speed up every project in their portfolio. With AI-powered permitting intelligence and expert guidance, we eliminate costly delays and bring predictability across the full lifecycle of commercial projects.

Today, permitting is the slowest, most uncertain part of building, spread across 19,000+ jurisdictions with different rules, timelines, and surprises. Pulley gives project teams the clarity and predictability they need to move from planning to opening without delays.

We support rollout programs for brands like J.Crew, Solidcore, and Hibbett Sports, as well as major data center buildouts, EV charging networks, and other commercial projects. ### ***About Givzey | Version2.ai***

*Givzey |* *Version2.ai* (http://version2.ai) *is a fully remote, AI-native company that created the Autonomous Fundraising category in 2024, when it researched, developed, and deployed the world's first Autonomous AI to address the labor shortage and capacity gap in nonprofit fundraising. VEOs don't just make staff more efficient; they manage donor portfolios independently, freeing human fundraisers to focus their time on the highest-value relationships while also closing transformational revenue for these organizations.*

*VEOs have already generated over $20M in fundraising revenue to date, including individual gifts as large as $100,000, at an opt-out rate of just 0.07%. Organizations deploying a VEO see 4x annual ROI on average, and the top 20% see 8x or higher. More than 250 VEOs are now deployed across higher education, healthcare, and nonprofit organizations in the U.S. and Canada, including UNICEF USA, Bucknell University, Wake Forest University, and William & Mary.*

*Adam Martel founded Givzey four years ago and leads the company as CEO. He previously founded, scaled, and sold Gravyty, the first company to develop and sell AI-first solutions to nonprofit organizations.*

**About the role**
------------------

This role sits next to our Product Manager and inside the Engineering team. You'll own the operational side of how we plan, ship, and report on work: the cycle cadence, ticket hygiene, release coordination, and cross-functional program management across product, engineering, ML, and CS.

This is a hands-on, proactive operating role. You're the person a fast-moving engineering team routes through. You keep the work moving without waiting to be asked, and you make the way the team works a little better every cycle.

**What you'll do**
------------------

### **Cycle operations**

* Run the team's three-week cycle cadence, including kickoff, daily standups, scope check-ins, demos, and retrospectives
* Keep blockers moving by getting each one to the person who can clear it, the same day
* Own the delivery record, the single tracker that shows the team, leadership, and CS where every piece of work stands
* Log lost time against each commitment the day it happens, and flag early when scope needs a cut

### **Ticket hygiene**

* Maintain high-quality tickets with clear acceptance criteria and correct prioritization
* Ensure work is properly structured (parents, dependencies, scope)
* Identify and clean up orphaned, duplicate, or stale tickets
* Push back on stories that are not ready for development

### **Cross-functional program management**

* Coordinate initiatives that span multiple teams, including Product, Engineering, ML, and Customer Success
* Manage dependencies across areas such as integrations, data pipelines, and customer readiness
* Act as the connective tissue to keep projects moving forward
* Route incoming requests to the right place (on-call, a small-fixes queue, or a future cycle) so work doesn't get assigned through DMs

### **Release coordination**

* Track what is included in each release
* Draft release notes and communicate updates clearly to stakeholders
* Partner with Customer Success to prepare for customer-facing changes
* Keep teams informed without creating unnecessary noise

### **Process improvement**

* Identify gaps and inefficiencies in current workflows
* Propose and implement practical improvements
* Continuously evolve team processes rather than simply maintaining them
* Run the team's written playbook from day one, and take ownership of it once you've run a full cycle

**What we're looking for**
--------------------------

#### **Experience**

4+ years as a project manager, technical program manager, or scrum master in a software organization.

#### **Working style**

* Comfortable in an engineering room. You can follow a technical debate without needing translation.
* Not afraid to push back when a senior dev says “just trust me.”
* You care about the craft of project management more than the title.
* You have opinions about how teams should work, but aren't dogmatic. Methodology is a tool, not a rulebook.
* You'd rather build a useful spreadsheet than implement a heavy framework.
* Comfortable being the only PM in a room of engineers.
* You're the hub. The team routes through you, so you're reachable and responsive during core hours, and you protect focus time without becoming hard to find.
* You finish what you pick up, completely and correctly, without needing someone to check on it.

#### **Mindset**

* Strong written communication. A lot of our work happens asynchronously and in writing.
* Comfort with ambiguity. We have a written process, and it changes every time we learn something. You'll run it and make it better.
* You care about where the work lands. The dollars our product helps move go to university scholarships, hospital research, and food banks, and that should matter to you.
* Curious about AI as a product surface, not just a hype cycle.
* Excited by building infrastructure from scratch instead of inheriting something polished.

**Nice to have**
----------------

* Experience in nonprofit tech, fundraising, or B2B Sa

jobs.description:
**About Net at Work**

Founded in 1996, Net at Work is one of North America’s largest technology advisors and solution providers for small and mid-size businesses. Our award-winning consultancy offers a rich portfolio of next-generation technology, industry expertise, implementation and managed services to help organizations derive value from the transformative benefits of technology.  
  
Through the integration of ERP, HCM and/or CRM solutions, Net at Work offers unique, industry-specific solutions and operation platforms that enable companies to compete more effectively in today’s digital economy. For more information, visit www.netatwork.com.

**About this Position**

The Employee Experience Project Manager (PM) is responsible for the successful planning, coordination, and delivery of Human Capital Management (HCM) solutions for Net at Work clients. This role centers around client excellence—building trusted partnerships, maintaining high satisfaction levels, and driving long-term value. The PM works directly with clients to clarify business requirements, propose scalable solutions, and ensure smooth implementation. The PM also supports the sales team by contributing to project scoping and helping to expand client relationships through ongoing service opportunities.

* Maintain a proactive approach to client communications, providing strategic updates and anticipating needs.
* Collaborate with internal teams to align project execution with client goals and desired outcomes.
* Ensure a seamless handoff to post-implementation support teams, maintaining continuity and trust.
* Identify opportunities for additional services or support, contributing to account growth and retention.

* Proven ability to work effectively in virtual and hybrid team environments and coordinate across organizational boundaries.

jobs.title: Service Delivery Manager - Remote, USA
jobs.description:
Service Delivery Manager

Location: USA, Remote

**Position Overview**

The Service Delivery Manager (SDM) is responsible for managing the successful delivery, deployment, and activation of Nile's networking solutions across an assigned portfolio of enterprise customers.

This role serves as the primary technical project manager, coordinating internal engineering teams, deployment resources, third-party partners, logistics, and customer stakeholders to ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope, and in accordance with Nile's delivery standards.

The SDM owns the customer deployment experience from project initiation through implementation, activation, stabilization, and formal handoff to the Customer Success organization.

The ideal candidate combines strong project and program management capabilities with technical networking knowledge, customer-facing leadership, and the ability to drive execution in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. End-to-End Service Delivery Management**

* Own end-to-end delivery execution for assigned customer deployments, ensuring projects are delivered on schedule, within scope, and according to established quality standards.
* Lead customer onboarding and deployment activities from project kickoff through implementation, activation, and operational handoff.
* Develop and maintain detailed project plans, milestones, resource requirements, dependencies, and delivery schedules.
* Establish clear ownership, accountability, and communication across all delivery workstreams.
* Proactively identify delivery risks, dependencies, and potential blockers, implementing mitigation plans before they impact customer outcomes.
* Manage multiple concurrent customer deployments across different geographies and levels of complexity.

**2. Customer Engagement and Stakeholder Management**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for customers throughout the deployment and implementation lifecycle.
* Lead project kickoff meetings, status reviews, technical workshops, and executive-level project updates.
* Set clear customer expectations around timelines, responsibilities, prerequisites, and deployment scope.
* Build strong relationships with customer IT leadership, project managers, technical teams, and business stakeholders.
* Proactively manage customer escalations and drive timely resolution in collaboration with internal teams.
* Ensure a positive, transparent, and consistent customer experience throughout the deployment journey.

**3. Cross-Functional Team Coordination**

* Coordinate closely with Sales, Solutions Engineering, Solutions Architecture, Service Engineering, Network Engineering, Product, Support, and Customer Success.
* Ensure appropriate technical discovery, design validation, and Bill of Materials (BoM) signoff before deployment execution.
* Work with Service Delivery Engineers (SDEs), deployment engineers, and external partners to coordinate implementation activities.
* Ensure alignment between pre-sales commitments and delivery execution.
* Drive effective collaboration between Day 0/Day 1 delivery teams and Day 2 Customer Success and Support teams.
* Identify organizational gaps and improve cross-functional processes to minimize handoff issues and operational friction.

**4. Deployment and Partner Management**

* Coordinate deployment resources, including field technicians, installation partners, cabling vendors, and logistics providers.
* Ensure deployment partners meet Nile's technical, operational, and customer experience standards.
* Validate site readiness, equipment availability, shipping schedules, installation requirements, and deployment prerequisites.
* Monitor partner performance, quality of work, productivity, and adherence to deployment schedules.
* Drive corrective actions when partner performance or deployment quality falls below expectations.
* Maintain consistent deployment processes and execution standards across regions.

**5. Operational Excellence and Process Improvement**

* Establish and maintain standardized deployment methodologies, project templates, delivery playbooks, and operational procedures.
* Drive continuous improvement across project execution, customer communications, resource utilization, and deployment efficiency.
* Identify opportunities to automate repetitive processes and improve delivery visibility through tools such as Jira and Nile's internal platforms.
* Develop scalable delivery practices that support Nile's growing customer base and global NaaS business.
* Maintain accurate project documentation, deployment records, risk registers, and customer acceptance documentation.
* Drive lessons-learned reviews and incorporate feedback into future delivery improvements.

**6. Customer Handoff and Day 2 Readiness**

* Ensure all deployment activities are completed and validated before customer handoff.
* Coordinate operational transition from Service Delivery to Customer Success, Customer Support, and Technical Account Management teams.
* Ensure customer environments are properly documented, configured, tested, and ready for ongoing operations.
* Conduct handoff meetings covering network architecture, deployment status, known issues, open actions, and operational considerations.
* Ensure outstanding deployment issues are tracked with clear ownership and resolution timelines.
* Support early-life stabilization and hypercare activities to ensure a smooth transition into steady-state operations.

**7. Reporting, Governance, and Performance Management**

* Provide regular project and portfolio updates to Service Delivery leadership.
* Maintain visibility into project health, milestones, resource requirements, risks, and customer satisfaction.
* Establish and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) for delivery execution and customer experience.
* Drive accountability across internal teams and external partners.

Bonneville Labs believes that research and development organizations can innovate faster when their mind-share is freed up from operations to focus on discovery and product development. ----------------

Bonneville Labs advances transformative bio‑economy solutions by removing operational friction for emerging biotechnology companies. Our coworking and traditional lab spaces support a community of Bio‑Doers who innovate faster when freed from operational burdens.

The Senior Program Manager works at both the high‑level planning layer and the day‑to‑day execution layer to support operational excellence, member experience, and continuous improvement.

This is a unique opportunity to be a part of a small team who is looking to empower humanity with the tools and knowledge of science and medicine to improve ourselves, our communities, and our world by making research tools accessible and understandable.

The People Science proprietary technology, Chloe (Consumer Health Learning & Organizing Ecosystem), is a consumer-friendly mobile app on the frontend, and a modular and configurable clinical research data management tool on the backend. If you are looking to utilize your clinical research experience and project management experience, keep reading.

**Job Summary**   
At People Science, the Clinical Research Project Manager utilizes their depth of clinical research experience and project management skills to oversee all operational aspects of running clinical studies according to and in compliance with ICH, GCP, and other applicable documents and regulations. You’ll manage timelines, coordinate with vendors and IRBs, and serve as the main point of contact for clients—all while helping us bring rigorous science to the wellness space. You'll work with our team of operations, product, technology, and marketing to ensure that the project and goals are achieved within timelines and budget.

● End-to-end management of studies; initiates, plans, manages, and facilitates closeout of clinical research projects and ensures successful execution of the study

jobs.title: Senior Program Manager, Application Security

As AI accelerates code creation, the real bottleneck has shifted to everything after the code – testing, deployments, application security, reliability, compliance, and cost optimization. Harness brings AI and automation to this “outer loop,” helping teams ship software faster while maintaining security and governance throughout the entire software delivery lifecycle.

Powered by Harness AI and the Software Delivery Knowledge Graph, the Harness Platform applies deep context and intelligent automation across the software delivery lifecycle with governance and policy-driven controls embedded throughout the platform.

jobs.title: Behavioral Health Care Manager
jobs.description:
Mindoula Health is seeking a **Behavioral Health Care Manager** to work with us full-time & remotely from anywhere within the United States. Mindoula's teams of Care Managers, supported by technology including a mobile engagement app, proprietary psychometrics, and predictive analytics, are the key to its success!

**How you'll contribute:**

* Efficiently accept patient handoffs from an Intake Care Manager and seamlessly continue care.
* Develop rapport with patients to create a safe therapeutic environment and assist them in developing insight into themselves, their patterns, and their relationships.
* Encourage patients to express feelings and discuss what is happening in their lives, assisting them in developing insight into themselves and their relationships.
* Guide patients in developing skills and/or strategies for managing problems and triggers to increase relapse prevention and reduce risk.
* Encourage patients to develop work skills and to participate in social, recreational, or other therapeutic activities that enhance interpersonal skills and develop social relationships through brief therapeutic interventions including but not limited to motivational interviewing, behavioral activation, and problem-solving therapy.
* Educate patients on medication, and the importance of medication adherence, and monitor patients' medication and medication-related problems. Reporting all findings to PCP and Psychiatric Consultants.
* Responsible for communicating treatment recommendations, ensuring recommendations are being addressed by PCP, and communicating updates reported by PCP and/or patient to a psychiatrist.
* Match daily calendar to documentation in Mindoula's electronic medical record - MMR.
* Reflect all billable activity in case of notes on MMR entered within 24 hours after billable activity.
* Present follow-ups to the psychiatrist with necessary information during case presentation.
* Counsel patients about their mental or physical illness, abuse, medication, and available community and social resources.
* Assess patients for risk, make quick evaluations for risk, develop safety plans and respond within the parameters outlined within their safety plan, formulating and performing crisis interventions ensuring the safety of patients as necessary.
* Monitor, evaluate, and record the patient's progress using validated assessments each month that the patient is in the program.
* Prepare and maintain all required records, reports, paperwork, and patients' diagnostic records, maintaining the confidentiality of patients at all times.
* Use clear and accurate verbal and written communication skills to facilitate communication with patients, patient's family/caregivers, staff, and the treatment team
* Produce high-quality documentation that enables the patients to receive the best treatment possible.
* Competently relate to patients, their families, and agencies involved with patients through above-average interpersonal skills.

**Education & Experience:**

* **Master's Degree** required in psychology, social work, or another behavioral health disciplines from an accredited college or university.
* **Bilingual** in Spanish and English a plus.
* Proficient in Microsoft Word, Google Suite (calendar, docs, sheets, slides, etc.)
* Strong data entry and documentation experience
* Work experience with Electronic Medical Records
* Experience with CBT, Behavioral Health Assessments and Motivational Interviewing

**Mission-Obsessed Teammates;**

It all starts with a team of humble colleagues who care passionately about our clients, our mission, and each other.

We approach our work as an act toward a revolution in healthcare. From clinicians to data scientists to engineers, everyone at Mindoula plays a critical role in leading members through a journey of healing and transformation.

**What we offer:**

* Insurance: Medical, dental, and vision insurance for you and your dependents
* Time Off: Holiday, Vacation, and Mental Health Days
* Wellbeing: Employee Assistance Programs and Wellness programs available to you and your dependents
* Culture: We work with and for each other
* Remote work 100%
* Responsibility: You get what you need to excel (MacBook, iPhone, remote technologies)

**Come be part of the solution!**

*Mindoula Health is committed to the principles of equal employment. We are committed to complying with all federal, state, and local laws providing equal employment opportunities, and all other employment laws and regulations. It is our intent to maintain a work environment that is free of harassment, discrimination, or retaliation because of age, race, color, national origin, ancestry, religion, sex, gender identity, pregnancy (including childbirth, lactation, and related medical conditions), marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, credit history, physical or mental disability, genetic information (including testing and characteristics), veteran status, uniformed service member status, or any other status protected by federal, state, or local laws.*

jobs.title: Business Operations Administrator (Part-Time)
jobs.description:
**About Auris Practice Solutions, LLC**

Auris Practice Solutions is a remote audiology services company that partners with hearing care practices and ENT groups across the country. Through the MaestroAuD® and MaestroFusion® product lines, Auris delivers clinical capacity and practice support that allow partner practices to serve more patients. Our team of remote audiologists and hearing care providers works in a growing number of states, and our operations must keep pace with that growth.

**Schedule:** Part-time, 15 to 20 hours per week

**Location:** Remote (United States)

**Classification:** W-2 Part-Time, Hourly (Non-Exempt)

**Compensation:** $28 - $35 per hour, commensurate with experience

**Reports to:** Strategic Operations Manager

**Position Summary**
====================

The Business Operations Administrator manages core business operations for Auris, working closely with the Strategic Operations Manager and the Managing Members. This individual manages monthly customer invoicing in QuickBooks, administers partner agreements once a practice has decided to move forward, supports the partner launch team, coordinates onboarding and offboarding, and maintains Auris registrations in the states where its people work. The position supports the business side of the company and collaborates with the clinical team and other departments. The role suits a highly organized, detail-driven professional who works independently, handles confidential information with discretion, and takes ownership of deadlines.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

**Operations Coordination Prepare and finalize business correspondence, agreements, and internal documents.**
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

* Track operational action items and deadlines and follow up to keep open items moving.
* Coordinate scheduling for partner, vendor, and internal meetings as requested.
* Maintain organized digital filing for finance, contracts, HR, and compliance records.

**Bookkeeping and Customer Invoicing**
--------------------------------------

* Prepare and send monthly invoices to partner practices in QuickBooks Online.
* Confirm that all consumables used during the month are added to each partner practice monthly invoice.
* Manage hearing aid fees due from partner practices to Auris, and confirm each fee is invoiced and collected.
* Track accounts receivable and follow up on past-due balances.
* Record transactions, process vendor bills, and reconcile bank and credit card accounts monthly.
* Collect W-9s from contractors and vendors, prepare year-end 1099 filings, and provide records to the outside CPA.

**Partner Contract Administration**
-----------------------------------

* Prepare partner agreements, schedules, and Business Associate Agreements from approved templates once a practice has decided to move forward.
* Manage the exchange of drafts and revisions with the practice, track open items, and escalate substantive changes to the Managing Members.
* Route final agreements for signature, file executed copies, and notify the launch team that the agreement is complete.
* Maintain a contract tracker with effective dates, renewal dates, and notice deadlines.

**Partner Launch Support**
--------------------------

* Complete assigned business-side launch tasks for new partner practices, including agreement completion, billing setup, and partner account records.
* Collect partner information and documents required for contracting and invoicing, and track business launch checklist items to completion.

**Onboarding, Offboarding, and HR Administration**
--------------------------------------------------

* Coordinate administrative onboarding and offboarding steps for employees and contractors, including agreements, equipment shipment and recovery, and system access requests.
* Update the professional liability carrier roster for provider additions and separations.
* Maintain confidential personnel and contractor files, and prepare employment verification letters.

**State Registration and Compliance**
-------------------------------------

* Register Auris as a foreign entity when a remote employee resides in a new state, and establish state withholding and unemployment insurance accounts.
* Maintain a compliance calendar of annual reports, registered agent renewals, and business license deadlines, and file on time.

**Qualifications**
==================

**Required**
------------

* Three or more years of experience in business operations, bookkeeping, or office management, preferably in a small or remote company.
* Working knowledge of QuickBooks Online, including reconciliations and invoicing.
* Experience with contract administration and electronic signature platforms.
* Familiarity with state business registration and state tax account setup.
* Strong organization, accuracy, and follow-through, with the ability to manage multiple deadlines independently.
* Proven discretion with confidential employee, financial, and health-related information.
* Clear, professional written communication.

**Preferred**
-------------

* Experience in a healthcare organization and familiarity with HIPAA.
* Experience with DocuSign, Rippling, and Microsoft 365.
* QuickBooks ProAdvisor certification.

**Work Environment**
====================

This is a fully remote position. The individual must maintain a private, secure workspace with reliable high-speed internet and be available during standard business hours on a consistent weekly schedule. Hours may increase during partner launches and year-end close.

**How to Apply**
================

Submit your resume with 2-3 references, and a brief cover letter describing relevant operations, bookkeeping, and contract administration experience via the link above.

*Auris Practice Solutions is an equal opportunity employer.*

 **The pay range for this role is:**  
28 - 35 USD per hour(Remote)

jobs.description:
Join us in pioneering breakthroughs in healthcare. For everyone. Everywhere. Sustainably.  
  
Our inspiring and caring environment forms a global community that celebrates diversity and individuality. We encourage you to step beyond your comfort zone, offering resources and flexibility to foster your professional and personal growth, all while valuing your unique contributions.

* The Customer Success Manager is a field position that supports our growing business by providing excellent customer support to increase, and maintain, customer loyalty that delivers continual product retention and customer feedback scores at or ahead of promoted classification.
* Support new and existing Siemens Healthineers customers with implementations, training, and troubleshooting.

o Work with customers to identify customer needs and requirements regarding training and verification/validation requirements.

o Develop and coordinate the customer training, implementation, and go-live plan to ensure customer implementation timelines are met.

o Act in project management capacity with customers for implementations, go-live installations and support of informatics / middleware connectivity with POC devices.

* Develop adoption strategies that focus on best practice change management and monitor the onboarding of customers (stakeholder engagement, change management, implementation plans) towards to increase the use of our Point of Care (POC) products
* Assist the customer in establishing & maintaining standardizations, standing orders and best practices post go-lives
* Identify and communicate potential “at risk” customers to the appropriate Siemens stakeholder.
* In partnership with the Account Executive, perform regular business reviews at required intervals including the assessment of error rates, reagent and consumable ordering, service contract management, customer satisfaction, potential unmet needs, improvement ideas, etc. with a view to further develop the partnership with the account.
* Communicate product update and improvement information to customers in accordance with regulatory, quality and compliance guidelines.
* Document all customer activities in the appropriate customer relationship management (CRM), Quality Management System (QMS) and/or other tools and processes in a timely and compliant manner as required
* Ensure that all detailed sales forecasting, training modules, and required reporting, including in all required internal quality and other tools and processes, are completed promptly and accurately.

Your expertise:

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in a biological science, nursing, or respiratory therapy
* 4+ years of work history as a medical technologist, point of care coordinator, respiratory therapist, or nurse is preferred
* Point of care testing experience, either end user or oversight is preferred
* Specific experience using Blood Gas analyzers strongly preferred.
* Experience project management within a hospital or laboratory setting
* Outstanding oral, written and presentation communication skills that can be applied to customers, with the ability to present technical information in a clear and concise manner
* Ability to demonstrate strategic critical thinking and focused, executable decision making
* Highly organized, able to manage multiple tasks and projects simultaneously
* Must be able to travel throughout designated territory to customer sites and other business locations in the USA as required

We are from different backgrounds, cultures, religions, political and/or sexual orientations, and work together, to fight the world’s most threatening diseases and enable access to care, united by one purpose: to pioneer breakthroughs in healthcare. For everyone. Everywhere. Sustainably.
