jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
**About Us**

Snappy Kraken is a marketing program leader in the financial services industry.

**We believe that our work helps people achieve greater freedom.**

* Our tools help financial advisors achieve greater freedom over their time.
* Our content helps people achieve greater financial freedom for their families.
* Our culture helps team members achieve greater freedom in where (and how) to live and work.

**Our innovative solutions set us apart.**

* Financial content is stale; we make it interesting.
* Marketing technology is complex; we make it simple.
* Financial advisor brands are bland; we make them captivating.

**The Purpose of This Role**

The **Customer Success Manager (CSM)** is a full-time, remote position at Snappy Kraken. *Accessibility requirements are dependent on the role but could be expected during standard business hours Monday through Friday.* This position is open to any candidates currently residing and eligible to legally work in the United States or Canada.

As a CSM, you will oversee Freedom360, our premium all-in-one marketing solution for financial advisors. You will serve as the primary partner for our highest-value clients - building strong relationships, guiding them strategically, and ensuring the seamless delivery of all program components.

Your focus will be helping clients achieve **real business outcomes**: successful campaign launches, improved marketing performance, and stronger client engagement.

**Primary Role & Responsibilities**

* Manage a portfolio of Freedom360 clients, ensuring consistent delivery of all program elements.
* Conduct regular **business reviews** with clients, highlighting performance and demonstrating program ROI.
* Support the **renewal process** by reinforcing value and client outcomes.
* Lead onboarding, campaign preparation, approvals, and timely content publication.
* Provide insights and suggestions to help clients make the most of the program.
* Build strong client relationships through regular communication (chat, phone, email, video).
* Maintain accurate client records in our CRM.
* Work with the Freedom360 Program Lead to improve processes and client experience.

**Primary Qualifications**

* **2–4 years of Customer Success** with proven success managing client outcomes.
* Demonstrated ability to lead **business reviews that showcase ROI and connect program value to client goals.**
* Experience in **SaaS customer success is required**; background in **Financial SaaS or Marketing Tech SaaS** is a strong plus.
* Strong communication and organizational skills.
* Comfortable presenting information and guiding client discussions.
* Tech-savvy, adaptable, and eager to learn new tools.
* Proactive and able to manage multiple priorities independently.
* Alignment with our core values: Pursue the Vision, Build Meaningful Relationships, Commit to Continuous Improvement, Solve with Purpose, Own Your Outcomes

**Perks & Benefits**

* Work Remotely
* Personal Days for when you need a break (on top of your regular vacation)
* Development Fund to help you grow
* Medical Insurance Options
* Parental/Maternity Leave
* Growth opportunities

As of November 2026, the expected compensation range for this position is **$60,000-65,000 USD/ $60,000-65,000 CAD** based on country of residence. This role is also eligible for **additional performance compensation** predicated on reaching quota or performance goals. Pay will be based on several factors, such as experience, certifications, location, market conditions, and other business and organizational needs. Snappy Kraken anticipates that the reasonably expected salary for this position could change in the future and retains the right to change or revisit the salary range according to business needs.

—

*As a remote company, it is critical to remember that our contributions and teams are interconnected and accessibility is the expectation.*

*At Snappy Kraken, diversity powers meaningful connections, impactful work, and great outcomes. Our culture of diversity and inclusion means we nurture an environment where each team member can do their best work.*

*The above job description is not intended to be an all-inclusive list of duties and standards of the position. Incumbents will follow any other instructions, and perform any other related duties, as assigned by their supervisor.*

 **The pay range for this role is:**  
60,000 - 65,000 USD per year(Remote (United States))  
60,000 - 65,000 CAD per year(Remote (Canada))

jobs.title: Outbound Customer Experience Supervisor
jobs.description:
Redwood Services is a national home services platform that partners with leading HVAC, plumbing, and electrical companies to help them grow and better serve their customers. As we continue to expand, we’re hiring an Outbound Customer Experience Supervisor to lead our welcome call team supporting tuck-in acquisitions. This is a hands-on leadership role. You’ll guide, coach, and support a team of Outbound Customer Experience Specialists while also making welcome calls yourself every day. The work isn’t sales-heavy or transactional. It’s about creating a great first impression, building trust, and gathering key customer information while introducing customers to their new service partner. If you’re an energetic, personable leader who leads by example and thrives in a fast-paced, high-volume calling environment, this is an opportunity to play a critical role in the success of every acquisition we make.

**Responsibilities:**

*Team Leadership*

* Supervise, coach, and support a team of Outbound Customer Experience Specialists to meet daily call volume and quality goals.
* Monitor call activity, outcomes, and data accuracy, providing real-time feedback and ongoing coaching.
* Train new team members on call flow, systems, and the VIP text club offer.
* Track and report team performance, flagging trends, challenges, and opportunities to leadership.
* Manage team schedules and coverage across multiple time zones.
* Serve as the first point of escalation for difficult calls or customer concerns.
* Model a positive, professional, and engaging tone that sets the standard for the team.

*Hands-On Calling*

* Make outbound welcome calls daily to existing customers of newly acquired companies, with a call volume balanced alongside leadership responsibilities.
* Introduce the new partnership between the customer’s current service provider and one of Redwood’s partner companies, ensuring customers feel confident and informed about the transition.
* Collect and update customer information accurately in the system.
* Invite customers to join the VIP text club and explain the benefits clearly.
* Handle inbound calls as needed and assist with basic scheduling when customers request service.
* Navigate multiple systems and platforms efficiently while documenting call outcomes.

**Qualifications:**

* Three (3)+ years of outbound call center experience, including at least one (1) year in a supervisor, team lead, or similar leadership role.
* **Candidates must live in the Memphis area. This role is remote, but you will be required to come into the office as needed.**
* Proven ability to lead by example while personally maintaining a high daily call volume.
* Experience coaching, monitoring call quality, and driving team performance to goals.
* Comfortable using call data and metrics to track performance and guide decisions.
* Open to starting as a full-time contractor with the opportunity to transition into a W2 employee with benefits based on performance and business needs.
* Ability to lead effectively in a remote environment with strong self-management and accountability.
* Ability to work a flexible schedule across time zones (typical shifts between 9am and 8pm depending on region).
* Strong communication skills with a friendly, confident phone presence.
* Tech-savvy and able to quickly learn new systems and teach them to others.
* Detail-oriented with strong data entry accuracy.
* Experience with ServiceTitan is a plus.
* Background in HVAC, plumbing, or home services is a plus.

**If you enjoy connecting with people, developing a team, and being part of work that directly impacts customer retention and growth, we’d love to hear from you.**

jobs.title: Enterprise Customer Success Manager, Prisma
jobs.description:
**Job title:** Enterprise Customer Success Manager

**Reports to:** Director, Customer Success - Prisma

**Department:** Priority Property Rev

**Location:** Salt Lake City, UT or Mountain West Region

**Grade:** 18

**About Priority Commerce:**

Priority Commerce is a leading financial technology company on a mission to deliver a personalized, easy-to-adopt financial toolset that accelerates cash flow and optimizes working capital for businesses. Our vision is to eliminate the barriers to unlocking revenue - empowering businesses to grow faster and operate smarter.

We achieve this through the Priority Commerce Engine, an innovative platform that combines payables, acquiring, and banking and treasury solutions. This unified approach allows businesses to streamline financial operations, reduce unnecessary costs, and uncover new revenue opportunities.

At Priority Commerce, we're driven by results. We expect our people to ***be known for results*** - bringing expertise, momentum, and relentless focus to every challenge, helping our clients and each other thrive.

**About the Role:**

Prisma seeks a commercially focused Enterprise Customer Success Manager to own and grow relationships with strategic multifamily clients. This role is accountable for customer retention,product adoption, revenue growth opportunities, and measurable business outcomes.

Based in Salt Lake City to be close to a key enterprise client’s headquarters, the CSM will establish a strong local presence through frequent in-person engagement with executive, regional, and operational stakeholders. The role combines strategic relationship management with proactive account leadership and cross-functional coordination.

**Responsibilities:**

**Strategic Account Management & Client Engagement**

* Own strategic enterprise relationships, with accountability for customer satisfaction, retention, adoption, and growth.
* Build relationships across multiple levels of the client organization through regular onsite and virtual meetings, reducing reliance on any single contact.
* Develop actionable account plans aligned with client priorities, measurable outcomes, and commercial opportunities.
* Lead executive and quarterly business reviews that communicate performance, ROI, recommendations, and next steps.

**Customer Retention & Revenue Growth**

* Monitor account health, anticipate risks, and coordinate mitigation plans to protect recurring revenue.
* Identify upsell, cross-sell, and expansion opportunities; partner with Sales to progress qualified opportunities.
* Increase adoption and utilization of Prisma solutions, including resident engagement and payment volume.
* Maintain clear visibility into renewal risks, growth opportunities, and account-level revenue forecasts.

**Customer Advocacy & Operational Excellence**

* Serve as the strategic point of contact, coordinating Support, TAM, Product, Sales, and Operations to resolve complex issues and deliver outcomes.
* Use performance data and customer feedback to recommend improvements and communicate the voice of the customer internally.
* Maintain accurate CRM records, including verified contacts, decision-makers, engagement history, risks, and commercial opportunities.
* Improve Customer Success processes, reporting, and account-management practices.

**What Success Looks Like:**

* Retention: healthy accounts and minimized revenue churn.
* Growth: qualified expansion pipeline and increased revenue from existing accounts.
* Adoption: increased platform utilization, resident adoption, and payment volume.
* Engagement: meaningful in-person meetings, executive relationships, and business reviews.
* Execution: accurate account intelligence, actionable plans, and timely risk mitigation.

**Candidate Requirements:**

* 5+ years in enterprise customer success, strategic account management, or a related client-facing role.
* Track record of managing complex enterprise relationships and influencing senior executives.
* Demonstrated success driving retention, adoption, and commercial growth.
* Strong analytical, commercial, communication, presentation, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to work independently and coordinate cross-functional initiatives.
* Experience with CRM platforms such as HubSpot or Salesforce.
* Must be based in the Salt Lake City area and available for frequent in-person client meetings and occasional additional travel.

**Preferred Experience:**

* Multifamily housing, PropTech, FinTech, digital payments, or enterprise SaaS.
* Knowledge of property management operations, payment processing, or resident technology.
* Management of large customer portfolios with significant recurring revenue.

**Work Environment & Culture:**

We believe that performance and experience go hand in hand - *an exceptional employee experience is earned through contribution*. We are a results-driven team, grounded in our core values: ownership, authenticity, service, trust, innovation, and camaraderie.

Our culture is built for those who want to make an impact. We challenge each other to grow, celebrate progress, and support one another through shared goals and real connection. Whether you're building technology, serving clients, or supporting internal teams, you’ll be part of a company that empowers you to perform at your best and be known for results.

**Compensation and Benefits:**

**Compensation range:** **$100,000 - $120,000**  
We invest in the whole employee - personally and professionally. Our benefits package is designed to support your well-being, growth, and success - both inside and outside of work.

**Financial Wellness**

* Bonus programs
* 401(k) match
* Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP)
* HSA and FSA options
* Financial wellness resources and employee discount programs

**Health & Well-being**

* Medical, dental, and vision coverage
* Mental health support for employees and dependents through Lyra Health
* Family planning and women’s health benefits through Carrot

jobs.title: Senior Product/Market Manager, Cardinal Health Brand Anatomic Pathology, Blood Bank, Hematology
jobs.description:
Our Global Medical Products and Distribution business manufactures, sources, and distributes Cardinal Health branded medical, surgical, and laboratory products, along with a broad portfolio of national brand products, serving healthcare providers. Within this segment, the Laboratory business supports more than 6,300 laboratories through a comprehensive offering of both Cardinal Health™ Brand and national brand products, as well as supply chain services and solutions.

The **Senior Product/Market Manager** is responsible for driving strategy, growth, and profitability across Cardinal Health’s Anatomic Pathology, Blood Bank, and Hematology product portfolios, with primary marketing ownership for products within the Cardinal Health Brand offering. This role serves as a senior individual contributor and portfolio expert, translating customer needs, market dynamics, competitive insights, and financial performance into actionable portfolio strategies. The Senior Product/Market Manager will identify opportunities to expand and optimize the portfolio through new products, suppliers, channels, capabilities, and commercialization strategies. This individual will partner closely with Sales, Global Sourcing, Finance, Quality and Regulatory Affairs, Supply Chain, Business Analytics, Legal, and supplier partners to execute portfolio priorities and drive profitable growth.

**Responsibilities:**

* Develops and executes portfolio strategies for the Anatomic Pathology, Blood Bank, and Hematology categories, with a focus on revenue growth, profitability, market share, and long-term portfolio competitiveness.
* Uses primary and secondary market research, voice-of-customer insights, competitive intelligence, and business performance data to identify customer needs, market trends, and new growth opportunities.
* Identifies and evaluates opportunities to expand the Cardinal Health Brand portfolio through new products, technologies, suppliers, private-label opportunities, channels, and capabilities.
* Develops business cases and market opportunity assessments to support portfolio investments and new product opportunities, including Stage-Gate activities and commercialization planning.
* Drives downstream marketing strategies and tactics designed to increase awareness, adoption, and growth of the Cardinal Health Brand portfolio.
* Manages product lifecycle strategies, including product introductions, positioning, pricing, portfolio optimization, and discontinuation recommendations.
* Monitors portfolio financial performance, including revenue, profitability, market share, service levels, back orders, and other key performance indicators, and recommends actions based on performance and market dynamics.
* Analyzes the competitive landscape, including competitor products, pricing, promotions, technologies, service offerings, and go-to-market strategies, to strengthen portfolio positioning and identify opportunities or risks.
* Develops product positioning, value propositions, sales tools, and educational materials that enable the commercial organization to effectively position the portfolio with customers.
* Provides product, market, competitive, and application training to Sales and other customer-facing teams.
* Partners with supplier organizations to evaluate emerging technologies, product innovations, and potential private-label opportunities while strengthening strategic supplier relationships.
* Partners cross-functionally with Sales, Global Sourcing, Finance, Business Analytics, Quality and Regulatory Affairs, Supply Chain, Operations, Inventory Management, and Legal to execute portfolio initiatives and resolve product, quality, supply, pricing, and customer issues.

* Builds relationships with laboratory customers and key stakeholders through voice-of-customer activities, advisory councils, sales collaboration, and customer site visits to inform portfolio priorities and identify opportunities for growth.
* Influences cross-functional partners and stakeholders to align around portfolio priorities and successfully execute initiatives in a matrixed environment.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Life Sciences, Medical Laboratory Science, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* Experience in product management, portfolio management, product marketing, or commercial strategy within healthcare, diagnostics, laboratory products, or a related industry. Product launch experience (Stage and Gate understanding, downstream marketing, successful implementation and process appreciation).

* Experience with clinical laboratory products, including Anatomic Pathology, Blood Bank, Hematology, private-label portfolios, or supplier partnerships, strongly preferred.
* Experience with market assessments, business plans, and product launches.
* Strong financial and analytical acumen, including pricing, profitability, business case development, and portfolio performance.
* Ability to translate customer, market, and competitive insights into actionable product and portfolio strategies.

Fullsteam is a leading provider of vertical software and embedded payments technology dedicated to helping businesses flourish by providing their customers with seamless experiences. -----------------------------

* Manage the onboarding process from initial welcome through implementation and transition to ongoing support.

**Why Sony Interactive Entertainment?**

Sony Interactive Entertainment isn’t just the Best Place to Play — it’s also the Best Place to Work. Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) is the company behind the PlayStation brand. As a subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation, we’re part of a proud legacy of innovation and excellence. SIE is a dynamic technology company, delivering cutting-edge hardware and network services to more than 100 million people and an entertainment leader, home to some of the most beloved and recognizable intellectual properties (IP) in the world. Our role at SIE is to create and nurture the experiences under the PlayStation brand, a name synonymous with entertainment excellence and creativity.

**Sr. Payroll Operations Specialist**
-------------------------------------

**Remote**
----------

**Role Summary**
----------------

Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) is seeking an experienced, organized, and collaborative **Sr. Payroll Operations Specialist** to support US and Canadian payroll operations within a global organization.

This role is responsible for coordinating, prioritizing, and executing payroll activities to ensure accurate, timely, and compliant payroll delivery. The ideal candidate understands end-to-end payroll processes, anticipates operational dependencies, and collaborates effectively with regional and global stakeholders.

The position requires hands-on payroll experience, strong operational judgment, and the ability to leverage technology, AI, and performance metrics to drive efficiency and continuous improvement.

**What You’ll Be Doing:**
-------------------------

**Payroll Operations**

* Coordinate and execute payroll activities across multiple pay groups and processing cycles, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and timely completion.
* Manage payroll schedules, checklists, audits, reconciliations, and competing priorities.Sr.
* Support complex payroll activities, including leaves of absence, international assignees, terminations, and special payments.
* Proactively identify and resolve payroll discrepancies, operational risks, and processing delays.

**Process Coordination and Collaboration**

* Provide day-to-day operational guidance and indirect leadership to Payroll Analysts by coordinating work assignments, aligning priorities, monitoring progress, and supporting timely, accurate payroll execution without direct people-management responsibility.
* Understand upstream and downstream payroll dependencies across HR, Benefits, Leaves, Finance, and other functions.
* Collaborate with regional and global stakeholders to resolve issues and improve payroll processes.
* Partner with technical teams on system-related issues, business requirements, and user acceptance testing.

**Employee Support and Continuous Improvement**

* Manage employee payroll inquiries through case management systems, ensuring timely and accurate resolution.
* Monitor payroll KPIs, including accuracy, timeliness, exceptions, and case resolution.
* Leverage AI, automation, and analytical tools to improve efficiency, accuracy, and operational workflows.
* Identify recurring issues, support root cause analysis, and implement process improvements.

**Compliance and Controls**

* Apply US and Canadian payroll regulations and established company policies.
* Execute payroll controls, audits, and reconciliations while supporting SOX compliance and audit requirements.
* Maintain accurate payroll documentation, procedures, and records.

**What We’re Looking For:**
---------------------------

* 7+ years of progressive payroll experience supporting US and Canadian payroll operations.
* Hands-on experience with **Dayforce Payroll and Workday HCM**; Dayforce Workforce Management experience preferred.
* Strong understanding of end-to-end payroll processes, compliance requirements, and operational dependencies.
* Experience supporting international assignees or cross-border payroll activities.
* Demonstrated ability to organize complex workflows, manage competing priorities, and meet critical deadlines.
* Experience working collaboratively within a regional payroll team in a global organization.
* Strong analytical, Excel, problem-solving, and communication skills.
* Experience with payroll audits, case management, process improvement, and performance metrics.
* Familiarity with AI and automation tools to improve payroll efficiency and accuracy.
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience; CPP, PCP, or PLP certification preferred.

**Measures of Success**
-----------------------

* Accurate, timely, and compliant payroll delivery.
* Effective prioritization and proactive resolution of operational issues.
* Strong collaboration across regional and global teams.
* Continuous improvement in payroll accuracy, efficiency, and employee service.
* Consistent adherence to payroll controls and compliance requirements.

At SIE, we consider several factors when setting each role’s base pay range, including the competitive benchmarking data for the market and geographic location.
  
  
Please note that the base pay range may vary in line with our hybrid working policy and individual base pay will be determined based on job-related factors which may include knowledge, skills, experience, and location.
  
  
In addition, this role is eligible for SIE’s top-tier benefits package that includes medical, dental, vision, matching 401(k), paid time off, wellness program and coveted employee discounts for Sony products. This role also may be eligible for a bonus package.

$135,900—$203,900 USD

$60,000–$80,000 annually + potential per-file bonus

### **Core Duties & Key Measurements**

**Position Title: Onboarding Specialist**

**Who We Are:**

As Nelson Mandela said, “Sport has the power to change the world. It has the power to inspire. It has the power to unite people in a way that little else does.”

At LeagueApps, we agree. Mission-driven at our core, every member of our team is committed to a world where all kids and communities can benefit from youth sports. jobs.description:
**FireMon delivers Network Security Policy Control for the Modern Enterprise.**

Most enterprises run firewalls from multiple vendors alongside cloud security groups and microsegmentation platforms, and no single console can say whether it all works together. We believe policy is the control plane for network security: it defines what the environment should do, and the infrastructure carries it out. FireMon gives security teams one place to see, govern, and prove that their policy is doing what they intend, across on-prem, cloud, and hybrid environments.

We're looking for a Senior Revenue Operations Analyst to be the analytical engine behind our GTM organization. You'll own pipeline reporting and forecasting, run and improve our Salesforce environment and GTM tech stack, and support annual territory, quota, and capacity planning. You'll partner with Sales leadership, Finance, Marketing, and CX to turn data into decisions that drive predictable revenue growth.

A key focus of the role will be modernizing GTM operations through automation and AI. You'll identify opportunities to streamline workflows, accelerate reporting and analysis, improve data quality, and leverage tools such as Claude to uncover insights and support better decision-making.

The ideal candidate combines deep hands-on GTM operations expertise across marketing and sales with strategic thinking, technical fluency, strong analytical skills, and a builder mindset.

### **About the role**

* Define and own the core GTM metrics framework, measuring performance from first lead engagement through pipeline, bookings, and revenue: pipeline generation, conversion rates by stage, win rate, average deal size, sales cycle, ACV/ARR growth, and net retention.

* Run full-funnel analysis from lead to closed-won to renewal, including win/loss, deal velocity, discounting, and pricing trends, to identify where deals stall and why and to inform sales strategy and deal desk policy.

* Build rep and team productivity analyses: ramp time, activity-to-outcome ratios, attainment distribution, and capacity utilization.

* Perform cohort and segment analysis (by industry, region, deal size, product, and channel) to guide where to invest.

* Build reporting and dashboards that join CRM, marketing, product usage, and finance data into a single view of the business, covering campaign performance, attribution, pipeline coverage and contribution, forecast accuracy, and GTM efficiency.

* Go beyond reporting what happened: use AI and analytical tools, including Claude, to run ad-hoc deep dives for the leadership team, surface trends, analyze why performance changed, and turn findings into concise recommendations with clear owners and next steps.

* Partner with Demand Generation, Digital, Field, Partner, and Product Marketing to evaluate program effectiveness and identify opportunities to improve conversion and ROI.

* Build capacity, quota, and scenario models with Finance and Sales leadership, including "what-if" analyses for headcount, pipeline coverage, and target-setting; maintain quota attainment tracking.

* Support sales compensation plan design, modeling, and monthly commission calculation and validation.

**Data Governance**

* Establish and enforce standards for database hygiene, normalization, deduplication, account hierarchies, segmentation, enrichment, campaign taxonomy, and data quality.

* Own and optimize FireMon’s GTM technology ecosystem, ensuring tools are integrated, adopted, scalable, and delivering value, and recommend where platforms should be added, consolidated, replaced, or eliminated.

* Maintain documentation of system architecture, integrations, workflows, and business rules.

### **Required Skills and Experience**

* 5+ years in Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, or GTM Operations, ideally at a B2B SaaS or technology company.

* Hands-on Salesforce experience: building reports and dashboards, configuring fields, flows, and validation rules.

* Proven ownership of the sales forecast process, pipeline reporting, and territory, quota, and capacity planning cycles for a multi-segment sales team.

* Strong SQL skills and hands-on experience with a BI tool (Tableau, Power BI, or Looker); advanced Excel / Google Sheets modeling (lookups, pivots, scenario models).

* Strong project management skills and comfort managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

* Clear written and verbal communication; able to translate ambiguous business questions into clear analysis and recommendations for executives, and to train and influence sales teams.

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Economics, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

### **Preferred Skills and Experience**

* Experience with statistical analysis, or with a cloud data warehouse (Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift).

* Experience with forecasting and revenue intelligence tools (e.g., Clari, Gong) and incentive comp platforms (e.g., CaptivateIQ, Spiff, Xactly).

* Experience supporting enterprise SaaS or cybersecurity GTM teams, including channel or partner-sourced deals and ABM or intent-driven marketing.

* Familiarity with CPQ and quote-to-cash processes.

* Familiarity with APIs, webhooks, integration platforms, or low-code/no-code automation tools.

**About the Position**

At Industrial Services Group, Inc., we take pride in continuous growth and development. The driving force behind our success is a skilled and dedicated team.

We are seeking a detail-oriented and organized **Project Coordinator** to support our Flooring Division. This position serves as a central point of communication between Sales, Operations, and Administration, ensuring projects run efficiently from initial planning through completion.

The ideal candidate will have strong organizational and communication skills, experience coordinating multiple projects, and the ability to work effectively with internal teams, vendors, and management.

**Key Responsibilities**

new_jobs.title: Business Operations Coordinator
new_jobs.description:
**Life is too short to work with jerks.**

Join our team at NCD, a top-tier insurance provider, consisting of a unique and eclectic group of winners, nerds, and gamers who balance a fun, kind, and thoughtful approach to life with an unwavering commitment to unparalleled member satisfaction. Our ecosystem is rooted in our five core values: Relentless Positivity, Growth Obsessed, Get it Done, Helpful Spirit, and Solution Driven.

We are not just coworkers, but a community, working tirelessly towards 'Spreading the Smile' to our members, agents, and each other. NCD is at the forefront of dental and vision insurance, in partnership with our carrier partners MetLife, VSP, and Zurich. Our continuous growth is a testament to our commitment to delivering outstanding agent and customer satisfaction.

If you are ready to win each day, are eager to grow, and aspire to contribute to an organization that is setting the pace in the industry, then we are looking for you. Together, let’s drive change and take NCD to new heights. Join us and become a vital part of our success story as we continue to transform lives and 'Spread the Smile.

**Summary:**

The Operations Coordinator plays a key role in ensuring the accuracy, efficiency, and timeliness of agent commissions, billing, and payment processes. This position supports the daily execution and continuous improvement of the company’s core operational workflows.  
  
This individual will collaborate closely with the Operations, Sales, and Finance teams to ensure that agent incentive payouts, agent commissions, and client billing, are processed accurately and on schedule. The role requires strong attention to detail, comfort working with data, and the ability to maintain organized documentation and clear communication across departments.  
  
The ideal candidate is someone who enjoys working in a fast-moving, positive environment and takes pride in delivering high-quality, consistent results. This role is a great opportunity for someone eager to learn, grow, and contribute to a team that values collaboration, innovation, and operational excellence.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Commissions**

* Prepare and process agent commission payouts accurately and on schedule, in line with company policy
* Maintain the payout calendar, tracking timelines, approvals, and dependencies
* Validate data from CRM and financial systems to ensure accuracy and consistency
* Reconcile payments against sales and billing records, and resolve discrepancies promptly
* Run recurring scrubs to catch duplicates, setup errors, and misaligned data before payouts run
* Partner with Sales Operations on commission setup best practices
* Improve reporting, automation, and documentation

**Incentive Programs**

* Partner with Sales Operations on the launch and delivery of agent incentive programs
* Deliver data pulls and tracking to measure program results all varying by partner and product
* Process incentive payouts accurately and on time
* Research and resolve questions and disputes about results and payouts
* Maintain an incentive calendar and clear records for every program
* Standardize templates and documentation so new programs launch smoothly

**Operations Support & Reporting**

* Maintain data accuracy and consistency across CRM systems and operational databases.
* Track, monitor, and report on key metrics related to incentives, billing performance, and operational efficiency.
* Partner with cross-functional teams to ensure clear communication and alignment on processes.
* Provide administrative and analytical support for department initiatives, special projects, and process improvement efforts.

**Qualifications**

* 1–3 years of experience in operations, commissions, or financial administration (insurance or financial services experience preferred).
* Exceptional attention to detail with the ability to identify and correct numerical or data inconsistencies.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; proficient in Microsoft Excel (formulas, pivot tables, lookups).
* Excellent communication and relationship-building skills; able to collaborate effectively across teams.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
* High level of integrity, discretion, and professionalism when handling sensitive financial information.
* Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree in Business, or a related field preferred (or equivalent experience).

**NCD Benefits**

* Company-paid health, dental, life, and disability insurance
* 401(k) with employer match
* Opportunity for professional development
* Work from home allowance and support
* Positive work environment
* Remote, office-based flexibility within the United States of America

**Equal Opportunity**

NCD is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to building a team that reflects a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. We believe our differences make us stronger and help us better serve our members, agents, partners, and each other.

new_jobs.title: Customer Experience — Drive-Thru, Americas
new_jobs.description:
**About DTIQ Technologies, Inc**

DTiQ is a global leader in intelligent video-based surveillance and loss prevention solutions, helping businesses improve operations and protect their assets.

With over 20 years of experience and more than 45,000 customers worldwide—including well-known brands like Adidas, Burger King, Hard Rock Café, KFC, McDonald’s, US Polo, and Yankee Candle—DTiQ supports over 8 million customer experiences every day.

We are proud to offer a collaborative, inclusive, and growth-oriented work environment where employees are encouraged to learn, develop new skills, and build long-term careers.

For more information on DTiQ visit our website (www.dtiq.com) or our LinkedIn page (https://www.linkedin.com/company/dtiq).

**Role Overview**  
DTiQ is seeking a customer-focused, commercially minded Customer Experience professional to support the growth and success of DriveThruIQ across the Americas.  
This role is responsible for ensuring customers successfully adopt, realize value from, and expand their use of DTiQ's Drive-Thru solutions. Working closely with Sales, Account Executives, Product, Technical Support, and Operations, the CX resource will support customer engagement throughout the customer lifecycle, from solution demonstrations and validation through deployment, adoption, retention, and expansion.  
The role will play a critical part in supporting new business opportunities, demonstrating the operational value of DriveThruIQ, and ensuring customers achieve measurable outcomes from their investment.  
The successful candidate will combine strong customer engagement skills with an understanding of QSR operations, technology adoption, and the commercial drivers behind customer retention and growth.  
**Key Responsibilities**  
**1. Pre-Sales Support & Solution Validation**

* Partner with the Senior Director of Sales and Account Executives to support qualified DriveThruIQ opportunities.
* Deliver product demonstrations and solution walkthroughs tailored to customer requirements.
* Translate customer challenges into relevant product capabilities and operational outcomes.
* Support technical validation, proof-of-concept activities, and pilot programs.
* Engage Product and Technical teams to address solution questions and ensure customer expectations are aligned.
* Develop the capability to independently lead standard demonstrations and validation activities, escalating strategic or complex opportunities to global CX leadership when required.

**2. Customer Onboarding & Adoption**

* Support a structured handover from Sales into deployment and Customer Experience.
* Coordinate with Technical Support, Operations, and Product to facilitate successful onboarding.
* Establish clear customer expectations, implementation milestones, and success criteria.
* Drive product adoption and ensure customers understand how to use DriveThruIQ effectively.
* Identify deployment issues, adoption barriers, and risks to customer outcomes, coordinating resolution with the relevant teams.

**3. Customer Retention & Relationship Management**

* Develop strong relationships with customer stakeholders across Operations, Technology, and Restaurant Development.
* Maintain regular engagement with key accounts to understand satisfaction, challenges, and changing business priorities.
* Monitor customer health, adoption, and engagement to identify potential retention risks.
* Coordinate action plans to resolve issues and improve customer outcomes.
* Escalate critical customer concerns and ensure clear ownership through to resolution.

**4. Account Growth & Expansion**

* Work alongside Account Executives to identify opportunities for additional sites, brands, products, and markets.
* Support account reviews by demonstrating product value and identifying opportunities for greater adoption.
* Identify upsell and cross-sell opportunities and communicate them to the relevant AE.
* Support legacy-to-Vision / NextGen upgrade discussions through product demonstrations, customer education, and solution validation.
* Help build customer business cases using operational outcomes and available performance data.

**Commercial ownership remains with Sales and the Account Executives; CX enables customer value realization and identifies opportunities for growth.**  
**5. Customer Advocacy & Value Realization**

* Establish measurable customer success criteria aligned to operational and commercial objectives.
* Support customer reviews that demonstrate product adoption, performance improvements, and realized value.
* Identify suitable customer references, testimonials, case studies, and peer-to-peer engagement opportunities.
* Work with Marketing and Sales to turn successful deployments into advocacy and new-business opportunities.

**6. Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Work closely with the Senior Director of Sales and Account Executives to align customer engagement with the regional GTM strategy.
* Partner with global CX leadership, including Belinda Miksa, on strategic accounts, complex engagements, and critical customer relationships.
* Coordinate with Product, Technical Support, and Operations to resolve issues affecting adoption and customer outcomes.
* Maintain clear handover processes, account ownership, escalation pathways, and communication across teams.
* Provide structured customer feedback to Product to inform roadmap priorities and improvements.

**Key Performance Indicators**  
Performance will be measured against agreed targets, including:

* Customer retention and renewal performance.
* Product adoption and customer engagement.
* Customer satisfaction and health.
* Successful onboarding and solution validation.
* Time to value following deployment.
* Identification and progression of expansion opportunities with Sales.
* Customer references, testimonials, and advocacy.
* Timely resolution and escalation of customer issues.

**Customer Experience & Account
